docs.title: 23.13.6. Implementing the actions of the application menu
docs.text:
Here we deal with the implementation of the menu actions. Let us recall the meaning of the links we have encountered:

ViewLinkTargetRoleTax calculation[Liste des simulations][main.php?action=lister-simulations]Request the list of simulationsTax calculation[Fin de session][main.php?action=fin-session]Request the end of the sessionList of simulations[Calcul de l'impôt][main.php?action=afficher-calcul-impot]Display the tax calculation viewList of simulations[Fin de session][main.php?action=fin-session]Request the end of the sessionUnexpected errors[Calcul de l'impôt][main.php?action=afficher-calcul-impot]Display the tax calculation viewUnexpected errors[Liste des simulations][main.php?action=lister-simulations]Request the list of simulationsUnexpected errors[Fin de session][main.php?action=fin-session]Request the end of the session

Remember that clicking a link causes a GET to the link's target. The actions [lister-simulations, fin-session] have been implemented with a GET operation, which allows us to use them as link targets. When the action is done with a POST, using a link is no longer possible unless it is combined with JavaScript.

From the actions above, it appears that the [afficher-calcul-impot] action has not yet been implemented. It is a navigation operation between two views: the JSON or XML server has no reason to implement it because it does not have the notion of a view. It is the HTML server that introduces this notion. We must therefore implement the [afficher-calcul-impot] action. This will allow us to review the procedure for implementing an action within the server:

  • we add a case to the [Action] enumeration: [case AfficherCalculImpot = "afficher-calcul-impot";];
  • we write the secondary controller [AfficherCalculImpotController] in the [Controllers] folder;
  • we add its file to the [dependencies] key of the [config.json] file;
  • we add the branch [Action::AfficherCalculImpot => new AfficherCalculImpotController()] to the [match] expression of the main controller;
  • we associate the state code returned by the controller, 800, with the tax calculation view in the [vues] key of [config.json].

The [AfficherCalculImpotController] controller is as follows:

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

// espace de noms
namespace Application;

// dépendances Symfony
use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\Request;
use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\Response;
use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\Session\Session;

// action [afficher-calcul-impot] : navigation vers la vue du calcul de l'impôt (application HTML)
final class AfficherCalculImpotController implements InterfaceController
{
    #[\Override]
    public function execute(array $config, Request $request, Session $session): ControllerResult
    {
        // changement de vue : il suffit de rendre le code d'état associé à la vue cible
        return new ControllerResult(Response::HTTP_OK, 800, "");
    }
}
  • line 14: like the other secondary controllers, the new controller implements the [InterfaceController] interface;
  • line 20: view changes are simple to implement: it is enough to return the state code associated with the target view, here code 800. On a view change, there can be no error.

docs.title: 23.13.7. Tests under real conditions
docs.text:
The code has been written and each action tested with [curl]. It remains for us to test the sequence of views in a real situation. We need a way to initialize the HTML session. We know that the parameters [action=init-session&type=html] must be sent to the server. To avoid having to type them in the browser's address bar, we add the script [index.php] to our application:

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

// redirection (code 302) vers [main.php] en mode [html]
header("Location: main.php?action=init-session&type=html");
  • line 6: [header] is a PHP function that adds an HTTP header to the response. The HTTP header [Location: main.php?action=init-session&type=html] asks the client browser to redirect to the indicated URL. PHP then gives the response the status [302 Found].

The script [index.php] is requested with the URL [http://localhost/php8-oct-2026/scripts-web/impots/version-12/index.php]. When the client browser receives the redirection to the relative URL [main.php?action=init-session&type=html], it will request the absolute URL [http://localhost/php8-oct-2026/scripts-web/impots/version-12/main.php?action=init-session&type=html] and the HTML session will start.

The start URL can be simplified to [http://localhost/php8-oct-2026/scripts-web/impots/version-12/]. When no document is specified in the URL, [Apache] uses the folder's [index.html] or [index.php] document. Here the script [index.php] will therefore be used. Let us check this with [curl]:

> curl -i http://localhost/php8-oct-2026/scripts-web/impots/version-12/
HTTP/1.1 302 Found
Date: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 16:51:53 GMT
Server: Apache/2.4.58
X-Powered-By: PHP/8.5.11
Location: main.php?action=init-session&type=html
Content-Length: 0
Content-Type: text/html; charset=UTF-8
  • line 2: the HTTP code [302] is a redirection code: the client is told that the requested URL has been moved;
  • line 6: the new URL is specified by the [Location] header. A browser follows this redirection with a new GET request. [curl] only does so if it is given the [-L] option.

In the browser, the developer tools (F12, [Network] tab) show the two requests: the 1st one receives the 302 response, the second the authentication view. Let us go: we now present a few view sequences. Let us request the start URL [http://localhost/php8-oct-2026/scripts-web/impots/version-12/]:

docs.title: 23.14. Client of the JSON web service
23.14.1. Client / server architecture
docs.text:
We are now interested in the JSON client [A] of the web service [B]. The client [A], like the web service [B], has a layered structure:

This architecture is reflected by the following code organization, in the folder [scripts-console/impots/version-12]:

scripts-console/impots/version-12
├── Dao
│   ├── ClientDao.php
│   └── InterfaceClientDao.php
├── Data
│   ├── config.json
│   ├── errors.json
│   ├── results.json
│   └── taxpayersdata.json
├── Main
│   └── main.php
├── Metier
│   ├── ClientMetier.php
│   └── InterfaceClientMetier.php
└── Tests
    └── ClientMetierTest.php

The other classes used by the client have already been encountered and explained. As for the previous clients, they are loaded from the folders where they were written:

ClassRole and originExceptionImpotsthe class of the application's exceptions. Version 5, [Entities] folderTaxPayerDatathe data of a taxpayer [marié, enfants, salaire]. Version 5, [Entities] folderUtilitairesreading and writing JSON files. Version 5, [Utilities] folderTraitDaoimplementation of the methods [getTaxPayersData] and [saveResults]. Version 5, [Dao] folderSimulationa tax calculation simulation. Version 12 server, [Entities] folder

The client uses the server's [Simulation] class: it is in this form that the server sends its simulations, and this [readonly] class with public attributes suits the client just as well as the server. The PHP 7 class [BaseEntity], from which the [Simulation] class of the PHP 7 client derived, no longer exists.

docs.title: 23.14.2.1. Interface
docs.text:
The interface of the [dao] layer is as follows [Dao/InterfaceClientDao.php]:

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

// espace de noms
namespace Application;

// l'interface de la couche [dao] du client du service web JSON de la version 12
// toutes les méthodes lancent une exception [ExceptionImpots] en cas d'erreur
interface InterfaceClientDao
{
    // lecture des données contribuables (implémentée par le trait [TraitDao])
    /** @return TaxPayerData[] */
    public function getTaxPayersData(string $taxPayersFilename, string $errorsFilename): array;

    // enregistrement des résultats (implémentée par le trait [TraitDao])
    /** @param Simulation[] $simulations */
    public function saveResults(string $resultsFilename, array $simulations): void;

    // action [init-session] : début d'une session de type json, xml ou html
    public function initSession(string $type = "json"): void;

    // action [authentifier-utilisateur]
    public function authentifierUtilisateur(string $user, #[\SensitiveParameter] string $password): void;

    // action [calculer-impot] : calcul de l'impôt d'un contribuable
    public function calculerImpot(string $marié, int $enfants, int $salaire): Simulation;

    // action [lister-simulations] : la liste des simulations de la session
    /** @return Simulation[] */
    public function listerSimulations(): array;

    // action [supprimer-simulation] : rend la nouvelle liste des simulations
    /** @return Simulation[] */
    public function supprimerSimulation(int $numéro): array;

    // action [fin-session]
    public function finSession(): void;
}

Comments

  • line 14: the [getTaxPayersData] method makes it possible to use the JSON file of taxpayer data. This method is implemented by the [TraitDao] trait of version 5;
  • line 18: the [saveResults] method makes it possible to save the results of several tax calculations in a JSON file. Here too, this method is implemented by the [TraitDao] trait. The latter delegates the work to the [Utilitaires::écrireFichierJson] method, which can transform any object into JSON from its public attributes: [TaxPayerData] objects in the previous versions, [Simulation] objects here;
  • lines 21-38: we have created a method for each of the actions accepted by the web service, except for the [afficher-calcul-impot] action, which is only used by the HTML application;
  • line 24: the [SensitiveParameter] attribute (PHP 8.2), already encountered: if an exception is thrown during the execution of the method, the value of the password will not appear in the stack trace;
  • the documentation comments (PHPDoc) [@return Simulation[]] and [@param Simulation[] $simulations] specify the contents of the arrays. PHP cannot type the contents of an array: the [array] type does not say that the elements are [Simulation] objects. These comments tell this to the [VS Code] editor (PHP Intelephense extension), which can then suggest the attributes of [Simulation] when iterating over the array.

docs.title: 23.14.2.2. Implementation
docs.text:
The [InterfaceClientDao] interface is implemented by the following [ClientDao] class:

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

// espace de noms
namespace Application;

// dépendances Symfony
use Symfony\Component\HttpClient\HttpClient;
use Symfony\Contracts\HttpClient\Exception\TransportExceptionInterface;
use Symfony\Contracts\HttpClient\HttpClientInterface;
use Symfony\Contracts\HttpClient\ResponseInterface;

// la couche [dao] du client du service web JSON de la version 12
// une méthode par action du serveur ; la session est maintenue avec le cookie de session
class ClientDao implements InterfaceClientDao
{
    // le trait de la version 5 implémente les méthodes [getTaxPayersData] et [saveResults] de l'interface
    use TraitDao;

    // le client HTTP
    private readonly HttpClientInterface $httpClient;
    // le cookie de session (null tant que le serveur ne l'a pas envoyé)
    private ?string $sessionCookie = null;

    // constructeur
    // $urlServer : l'URL du service web JSON
    // $httpClientOptions : des options du client HTTP (verify_peer, verify_host...)
    // $verbose : à true, les réponses du serveur sont affichées sur la console
    public function __construct(
        private readonly string $urlServer,
        array $httpClientOptions = [],
        private readonly bool $verbose = true,
    ) {
        $this->httpClient = HttpClient::create($httpClientOptions);
    }

Comments

  • line 19: the class uses the [TraitDao] trait, which implements two methods of the interface:
    • [getTaxPayersData(string $taxPayersFilename, string $errorsFilename): array];
    • [saveResults(string $resultsFilename, array $simulations): void];
  • line 22: Symfony's HTTP client is created only once, by the constructor, and is used for all requests. The PHP 7 client created a new HTTP client in each method;
  • line 24: the session cookie. Its role was described with the version 9 client. It is [null] as long as the server has not sent it;
  • lines 30-34: the constructor receives three parameters, two of which are promoted to attributes:
    • the URL [$urlServer] of the JSON web service;
    • the options [$httpClientOptions] of the HTTP client. They come from the configuration file: as for version 11, these are the [verify_peer] and [verify_host] options, which make it possible to work with the self-signed certificate of [Laragon]'s [https] server;
    • a boolean [$verbose] which, when [true], indicates that the class must display the server's responses on the console.

docs.title: The [initSession] method
docs.text:
The [initSession] method is implemented as follows:

    // action [init-session] : elle doit être la 1re action demandée au serveur
    #[\Override]
    public function initSession(string $type = "json"): void
    {
        // GET main.php?action=init-session&type=json - la réponse est un simple message
        $this->sendRequest("GET", ["action" => "init-session", "type" => $type]);
    }

Since the [init-session] action must be the 1st action requested from the web service, the [initSession] method will be the 1st method of the [dao] layer to be called.

Comments

  • line 40: the desired session type is passed as a parameter. If there is no parameter, a JSON session will be started. A JSON client can request an XML session: it will get the XML responses of version 11, which it will not be able to use;
  • line 43: a GET request is made to the web service. Its two parameters are placed in the URL: [main.php?action=init-session&type=json]. The server's response (a simple message) is not used. The private method [sendRequest] throws an exception if the HTTP code of the response is other than 200 OK.

The PHP 7 client repeated in each of its methods the creation of the HTTP client, the preparation of the request options (including the session cookie) and the call to the [getResponse] method. We have factored this work out into the private method [sendRequest].

docs.title: The [sendRequest] method
docs.text:
// envoi d'une requête au serveur et exploitation de sa réponse
    // $method : GET ou POST
    // $query : les paramètres de l'URL
    // $body : les paramètres postés (POST seulement)
    // rend l'élément [réponse] de la réponse JSON du serveur
    private function sendRequest(string $method, array $query, array $body = []): mixed
    {
        // les options de la requête
        $options = ["query" => $query];
        if ($body !== []) {
            // les paramètres postés sont envoyés sous la forme [param1=v1&param2=v2...]
            $options["body"] = $body;
        }
        if ($this->sessionCookie !== null) {
            // on renvoie au serveur le cookie de session qu'il nous a envoyé
            $options["headers"] = ["Cookie" => $this->sessionCookie];
        }
        // on fait la requête - la réponse ne sera réellement lue que par [getResponse]
        $response = $this->httpClient->request($method, $this->urlServer, $options);
        // on exploite la réponse
        return $this->getResponse($response);
    }

Comments

  • line 51: the method receives the HTTP method of the request (GET or POST), the URL parameters and, for a POST, the posted parameters. The [$body] parameter is optional: it defaults to the empty array;
  • line 54: the [query] option of Symfony's HTTP client contains the URL parameters. Symfony encodes them itself (the [numéro] parameter of the [supprimer-simulation] action contains an accented character);
  • line 57: when the [body] option is an array, Symfony sends the posted parameters in the form [param1=v1&param2=v2…] with the header [Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded], as a browser posting a form does;
  • lines 59-61: from the 2nd request onwards, we send back to the server the session cookie it sent us. This is how the server finds the client's session;
  • line 64: the request is prepared. Symfony's HTTP client is asynchronous: the request is actually sent and the response read when the status, the headers or the content of the response are requested, which is what the [getResponse] method does;
  • line 66: we return the [réponse] element of the server's response.

docs.title: The [getResponse] method
docs.text:
The [getResponse] method is responsible for using the web service's response:

    // exploitation de la réponse du serveur
    // rend l'élément [réponse] de la réponse JSON {"action": ..., "état": ..., "réponse": ...}
    private function getResponse(ResponseInterface $response): mixed
    {
        try {
            // le statut, les entêtes et le document JSON de la réponse, même en cas d'erreur (paramètre false)
            $statusCode = $response->getStatusCode();
            $headers = $response->getHeaders(false);
            $json = $response->getContent(false);
        } catch (TransportExceptionInterface $ex) {
            // le serveur n'a pu être joint
            throw new ExceptionImpots("Erreur de communication avec le serveur ({$ex->getMessage()})", 40, $ex);
        }
        // logs
        if ($this->verbose) {
            print "$json\n";
        }
        // le cookie de session : on garde le dernier envoyé par le serveur
        // (l'action [fin-session] supprime l'ancien cookie et en envoie un nouveau)
        foreach ($headers["set-cookie"] ?? [] as $cookie) {
            if (preg_match('/^PHPSESSID=([^;]+)/', $cookie, $champs) === 1) {
                $this->sessionCookie = "PHPSESSID=$champs[1]";
            }
        }
        // décodage de la réponse JSON
        try {
            $array = json_decode($json, true, flags: JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);
        } catch (\JsonException) {
            $array = null;
        }
        if (!is_array($array) || !array_key_exists("réponse", $array)) {
            throw new ExceptionImpots("Réponse du serveur invalide [$json]", 41);
        }
        // erreur ?
        if ($statusCode !== 200) {
            // le message de l'exception est la réponse du serveur complétée par son statut HTTP
            $message = json_encode(
                ["statut HTTP" => $statusCode] + $array,
                JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE | JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES | JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR
            );
            throw new ExceptionImpots($message, 42);
        }
        // on rend l'élément utile de la réponse
        return $array["réponse"];
    }

Comments

  • line 71: the method is private. Its parameter is of type [ResponseInterface], the interface implemented by all the responses of Symfony's HTTP client. The PHP 7 client used the type [CurlResponse], the class of the response when the HTTP client is implemented with the [curl] library: the [dao] layer depended needlessly on the implementation chosen by Symfony;
  • lines 73-80: we retrieve the status, the headers and the content of the response. The [false] parameter prevents Symfony from throwing an exception when the status of the HTTP response is in the ranges [3xx, 4xx, 5xx]. If the server cannot be reached, Symfony throws an exception of type [TransportExceptionInterface], which we transform into an [ExceptionImpots] exception with code 40, as in the previous versions;
  • lines 83-84: if we are in [$verbose] mode, we display the server's response on the console;
  • lines 88-90: we retrieve the session cookie. The PHP 7 client only did so in the [initSession] method. We do it after each request, because the version 12 server changes the session cookie during the [fin-session] action: it sends two [Set-Cookie] headers, the 1st to delete the old cookie ([PHPSESSID=deleted]), the second for the new one. The loop keeps the last one. The regular expression [/^PHPSESSID=([^;]+)/] captures the value of the cookie up to the 1st semicolon, which separates the value from the cookie's attributes (path, expires…);
  • line 95: the JSON string is decoded into an array. The [JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR] option causes a [JsonException] exception to be thrown if the string is not valid JSON;
  • lines 99-100: if the response is not a JSON object having the [réponse] key, it is not a response from our web service. We throw an exception with code 41;
  • lines 103-109: if the status of the server's HTTP response is other than 200, we throw an exception with code 42 whose message is the server's JSON response, supplemented with the HTTP status, as for the previous clients. The [+] operator applied to two associative arrays combines them: the array [["statut HTTP" => $statusCode]] is supplemented with the keys [action, état, réponse] of the [$array] array;
  • line 112: the useful information is in [$array["réponse"]]. Depending on the action, it is a message, an associative array (a simulation) or a list of associative arrays (simulations). The return type of the method is therefore [mixed].

docs.title: The [authentifierUtilisateur] method
docs.text:
The [authentifierUtilisateur] method is as follows:

    // action [authentifier-utilisateur]
    #[\Override]
    public function authentifierUtilisateur(string $user, #[\SensitiveParameter] string $password): void
    {
        // POST main.php?action=authentifier-utilisateur avec les paramètres postés [user, password]
        $this->sendRequest(
            "POST",
            ["action" => "authentifier-utilisateur"],
            ["user" => $user, "password" => $password]
        );
    }

Comments

  • line 121: the client's request is a POST;
  • line 122: the single URL parameter;
  • line 123: the POST parameters;
  • the response is not used: we know that in the event of an error (HTTP code other than 200), the [getResponse] method itself throws an exception.

docs.title: The [calculerImpot] method
docs.text:
// action [calculer-impot]
    #[\Override]
    public function calculerImpot(string $marié, int $enfants, int $salaire): Simulation
    {
        // POST main.php?action=calculer-impot avec les paramètres postés [marié, enfants, salaire]
        $réponse = $this->sendRequest(
            "POST",
            ["action" => "calculer-impot"],
            ["marié" => $marié, "enfants" => $enfants, "salaire" => $salaire]
        );
        // la réponse est le tableau des attributs d'une simulation
        return self::toSimulation($réponse);
    }

Comments

  • line 134: the single URL parameter;
  • line 135: the three POST parameters;
  • line 138: if we get here, it means the [getResponse] method did not throw an exception. The response is the associative array of the attributes of a simulation. The [toSimulation] method, presented a little further on, turns it into a [Simulation] object.

docs.title: The [listerSimulations] method
docs.text:
// action [lister-simulations]
    #[\Override]
    public function listerSimulations(): array
    {
        // GET main.php?action=lister-simulations
        $réponse = $this->sendRequest("GET", ["action" => "lister-simulations"]);
        // la réponse est une liste de simulations
        return self::getSimulations($réponse);
    }

Comments

  • line 146: a GET request with the single parameter [action];
  • line 148: the transformation of the response into a list of [Simulation] objects is entrusted to the private method [getSimulations].

docs.title: The [getSimulations] method
docs.text:
// transforme la liste de tableaux associatifs reçue du serveur en liste d'objets [Simulation]
    /** @return Simulation[] */
    private static function getSimulations(array $réponse): array
    {
        return array_map(self::toSimulation(...), $réponse);
    }

    // transforme un tableau associatif [marié, enfants, salaire, impôt, ...] en objet [Simulation]
    private static function toSimulation(array $attributs): Simulation
    {
        // les clés du tableau sont les noms des paramètres du constructeur de [Simulation]
        return new Simulation(...$attributs);
    }

Comments

  • line 153: the method receives the server's response, a list of associative arrays each having all the attributes of a simulation. It uses no attribute of the object: it is static and called by [self::getSimulations(...)];
  • line 155: the [array_map] function applies the [toSimulation] method to each of the elements of the list and returns the list of results. The syntax [self::toSimulation(...)] (PHP 8.1, "first-class callable syntax") creates an anonymous function (a [Closure]) from the [toSimulation] method. It replaces the old syntax [[self::class, "toSimulation"]];
  • line 162: the [...] operator unpacks the [$attributs] array into constructor arguments. Since PHP 8.1, the string keys of the array become named arguments: the [marié] key feeds the [$marié] parameter, the [impôt] key the [$impôt] parameter, etc., whatever the order of the keys in the array. If the server sent a key unknown to the constructor, PHP would throw an [Error];
  • the PHP 7 client used the [setFromArrayOfAttributes] method of the [BaseEntity] class to initialize the [Simulation] object with the elements of the array. Note that the JSON serialization of its [Simulation] objects contained the spurious attribute [arrayOfAttributes] inherited from the [BaseEntity] class. This is no longer the case.

docs.title: The [supprimerSimulation] method
docs.text:
// action [supprimer-simulation]
    #[\Override]
    public function supprimerSimulation(int $numéro): array
    {
        // GET main.php?action=supprimer-simulation&numéro=1
        $réponse = $this->sendRequest("GET", ["action" => "supprimer-simulation", "numéro" => $numéro]);
        // le serveur rend la nouvelle liste des simulations
        return self::getSimulations($réponse);
    }

Comments

  • line 170: we make a GET request with two parameters in the URL;
  • line 172: after a deletion, the server returns the new list of simulations. We return this list.

docs.title: The [finSession] method
docs.text:
A working session with the web service normally ends with a call to the [finSession] method:

    // action [fin-session]
    #[\Override]
    public function finSession(): void
    {
        // GET main.php?action=fin-session - la réponse est un simple message
        $this->sendRequest("GET", ["action" => "fin-session"]);
    }

Comments

  • line 180: we make a GET request with the single parameter [action]. An exception will be thrown if the HTTP code of the response is other than 200. The server responds with a new session cookie, which the [getResponse] method stores: subsequent requests will be made in the new session, where the user is not authenticated.

docs.title: 23.14.3.1. The interface
docs.text:
The interface of the [métier] layer is as follows [Metier/InterfaceClientMetier.php]:

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

// espace de noms
namespace Application;

// l'interface de la couche [métier] du client du service web JSON de la version 12
interface InterfaceClientMetier
{
    // calcul des impôts en mode batch : la seule méthode propre à la couche [métier]
    // les résultats ne sont enregistrés que si [$resultsFileName] n'est pas null
    public function executeBatchImpots(
        string $taxPayersFileName,
        string $errorsFileName,
        ?string $resultsFileName = null
    ): void;

    // les méthodes suivantes sont celles de la couche [dao]
    // calcul de l'impôt d'un contribuable
    public function calculerImpot(string $marié, int $enfants, int $salaire): Simulation;

    // enregistrement des résultats
    /** @param Simulation[] $simulations */
    public function saveResults(string $resultsFilename, array $simulations): void;

    // début de session
    public function initSession(string $type = "json"): void;

    // authentification
    public function authentifierUtilisateur(string $user, #[\SensitiveParameter] string $password): void;

    // liste des simulations
    /** @return Simulation[] */
    public function listerSimulations(): array;

    // suppression d'une simulation
    /** @return Simulation[] */
    public function supprimerSimulation(int $numéro): array;

    // fin de session
    public function finSession(): void;
}

Comments

  • line 13: only the [executeBatchImpots] method is specific to the [métier] layer. All the others belong to the [dao] layer, which implements them;
  • line 16: the results file is optional. If it is absent, the results are not saved. The parameter is of type [?string] (string or [null]). We have placed it in last position: an optional parameter must follow the required parameters. The PHP 7 course declared [string $resultsFileName] and passed [NULL] to the method, which causes a [TypeError] error in [strict_types=1] mode.

docs.title: 23.14.3.2. The [ClientMetier] class
docs.text:
The class implementing the [métier] layer is as follows:

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

// espace de noms
namespace Application;

// la couche [métier] du client : le calcul de l'impôt est fait par le serveur
class ClientMetier implements InterfaceClientMetier
{
    // la couche [dao] est injectée par le constructeur
    public function __construct(private readonly InterfaceClientDao $clientDao)
    {
    }

    // calcul des impôts en mode batch
    #[\Override]
    public function executeBatchImpots(
        string $taxPayersFileName,
        string $errorsFileName,
        ?string $resultsFileName = null
    ): void {
        // on laisse remonter les exceptions qui proviennent de la couche [dao]
        // on récupère les données contribuables
        $taxPayersData = $this->clientDao->getTaxPayersData($taxPayersFileName, $errorsFileName);
        // on calcule l'impôt de chacun des contribuables : le serveur mémorise les simulations dans la session
        $simulations = array_map(
            fn(TaxPayerData $taxPayerData): Simulation => $this->calculerImpot(
                $taxPayerData->marié,
                $taxPayerData->enfants,
                $taxPayerData->salaire
            ),
            $taxPayersData
        );
        // enregistrement des résultats, s'il est demandé
        if ($resultsFileName !== null) {
            $this->clientDao->saveResults($resultsFileName, $simulations);
        }
    }

    // les autres méthodes délèguent le travail à la couche [dao]
    #[\Override]
    public function calculerImpot(string $marié, int $enfants, int $salaire): Simulation
    {
        return $this->clientDao->calculerImpot($marié, $enfants, $salaire);
    }

    #[\Override]
    public function saveResults(string $resultsFilename, array $simulations): void
    {
        $this->clientDao->saveResults($resultsFilename, $simulations);
    }

    #[\Override]
    public function initSession(string $type = "json"): void
    {
        $this->clientDao->initSession($type);
    }

    #[\Override]
    public function authentifierUtilisateur(string $user, #[\SensitiveParameter] string $password): void
    {
        $this->clientDao->authentifierUtilisateur($user, $password);
    }

    #[\Override]
    public function listerSimulations(): array
    {
        return $this->clientDao->listerSimulations();
    }

    #[\Override]
    public function supprimerSimulation(int $numéro): array
    {
        return $this->clientDao->supprimerSimulation($numéro);
    }

    #[\Override]
    public function finSession(): void
    {
        $this->clientDao->finSession();
    }
}

Comments

  • line 12: to be built, the [métier] layer needs a reference to the [dao] layer. It is injected by the constructor and becomes a read-only attribute through parameter promotion;
  • lines 18-22: only the [executeBatchImpots] method is specific to the [métier] layer. The implementation of the other methods delegates the work to be done to the methods of the same names in the [dao] layer;
  • line 25: we ask the [dao] layer for the taxpayers' data in an array of objects of type [TaxPayerData];
  • lines 27-34: we calculate the tax for each of the taxpayers of the [$taxPayersData] array. The arrow function (PHP 7.4) called by [array_map] returns, for each taxpayer, the [Simulation] object returned by the server. Each calculation is also stored by the server in the user's session;
  • lines 36-37: the results are saved in a JSON file only if a file name has been given.

Note: the [métier] layer does almost nothing. We could decide to remove it and gather everything in the [dao] layer.

docs.title: 23.14.4. The main script
docs.text:
The main script is configured by the following [Data/config.json] file:

{
    "urlServer": "https://localhost/php8-oct-2026/scripts-web/impots/version-12/main.php",
    "user": {
        "login": "admin",
        "passwd": "admin"
    },
    "httpClientOptions": {
        "verify_peer": false,
        "verify_host": false
    },
    "taxPayersDataFilename": "Data/taxpayersdata.json",
    "resultsFilename": "Data/results.json",
    "errorsFilename": "Data/errors.json",
    "dependencies": [
        "../version-05/Entities/ExceptionImpots.php",
        "../version-05/Entities/TaxPayerData.php",
        "../version-05/Utilities/Utilitaires.php",
        "../version-05/Dao/TraitDao.php",
        "../../../scripts-web/impots/version-12/Entities/Simulation.php",
        "Dao/InterfaceClientDao.php",
        "Dao/ClientDao.php",
        "Metier/InterfaceClientMetier.php",
        "Metier/ClientMetier.php"
    ]
}
  • line 2: the URL of the main controller of the version 12 server. We use the [https] scheme: [Laragon]'s Apache server accepts both the [http] and [https] schemes;
  • line 3: the user's credentials;
  • line 7: the HTTP client options, already used by the version 11 client: the server's self-signed certificate is not verified;
  • lines 14-24: the application files to be loaded, relative to the client's [version-12] folder. They include the server's [Simulation] class. The PHP 7 course also gave an absolute root folder [rootDirectory] and the absolute path of Composer's autoloader. As for the previous versions, the paths are now calculated from the [__DIR__] constant: the [php8-oct-2026] folder can be moved without modifying the configuration.

The main script [Main/main.php] is as follows:

<?php

// respect strict des types déclarés des paramètres et des résultats des fonctions
declare(strict_types=1);

// espace de noms
namespace Application;

// le dossier racine du client : les chemins du fichier de configuration sont relatifs à ce dossier
const ROOT_DIRECTORY = __DIR__ . "/..";
// chemin du fichier de configuration
const CONFIG_FILENAME = ROOT_DIRECTORY . "/Data/config.json";

// on récupère la configuration
$config = json_decode(file_get_contents(CONFIG_FILENAME), true, flags: JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);

// on inclut les dépendances nécessaires au script : bibliothèques tierces (Symfony) puis fichiers de l'application
require_once ROOT_DIRECTORY . "/../../../vendor/autoload.php";
foreach ($config["dependencies"] as $dependency) {
    require_once ROOT_DIRECTORY . "/$dependency";
}

// les chemins des fichiers de données
$taxPayersDataFilename = ROOT_DIRECTORY . "/" . $config["taxPayersDataFilename"];
$resultsFilename = ROOT_DIRECTORY . "/" . $config["resultsFilename"];
$errorsFilename = ROOT_DIRECTORY . "/" . $config["errorsFilename"];

// création de la couche [dao] - les réponses du serveur seront affichées (verbose)
$clientDao = new ClientDao($config["urlServer"], $config["httpClientOptions"], verbose: true);
// création de la couche [métier]
$clientMetier = new ClientMetier($clientDao);

// un dialogue complet avec le service web JSON
try {
    // initialisation d'une session JSON
    $clientMetier->initSession("json");
    // authentification
    $clientMetier->authentifierUtilisateur($config["user"]["login"], $config["user"]["passwd"]);
    // calcul des impôts en mode batch, sans enregistrement des résultats (pas de paramètre [resultsFileName])
    $clientMetier->executeBatchImpots(
        taxPayersFileName: $taxPayersDataFilename,
        errorsFileName: $errorsFilename
    );
    // liste des simulations
    $clientMetier->listerSimulations();
    // suppression de la simulation n° 1 (la 2e de la liste)
    $simulations = $clientMetier->supprimerSimulation(1);
    // enregistrement des simulations restantes
    $clientMetier->saveResults($resultsFilename, $simulations);
    print count($simulations) . " simulations ont été enregistrées dans le fichier [{$config["resultsFilename"]}]\n";
    // fin de session
    $clientMetier->finSession();
    // action dans la nouvelle session, où l'on n'est pas authentifié : doit échouer
    $clientMetier->listerSimulations();
} catch (ExceptionImpots $ex) {
    // on affiche l'erreur
    print "Erreur n° {$ex->getCode()} : {$ex->getMessage()}\n";
}
// fin
print "Terminé\n";

Comments

  • lines 10-15: use of the configuration file [config.json];
  • lines 18-20: loading of all the dependencies;
  • lines 24-26: the absolute paths of the data files;
  • lines 29-31: construction of the [dao] and [métier] layers. The [$verbose] parameter is passed by name: [verbose: true] is more meaningful than a plain [true];
  • line 36: initialization of a JSON session;
  • line 38: we authenticate with the server;
  • lines 40-43: tax calculation for a series of taxpayers. We do not save the results: thanks to named arguments, we simply omit the optional parameter [resultsFileName];
  • line 45: we request the results of all these calculations;
  • line 47: we delete simulation no. 1 (the 2nd in the list);
  • line 49: we save the remaining simulations;
  • line 52: we end the session. The server deletes the session and starts a new one;
  • line 54: we request the list of simulations. In the new session, the user is not authenticated. We should therefore get an exception saying that we are not authenticated.

docs.title: 23.14.5. [PHPUnit] tests
docs.text:
As for the previous clients, the version 12 client can be subjected to [PHPUnit] tests. The test class [Tests/ClientMetierTest.php] is similar to that of the previous clients:

<?php

// respect strict des types déclarés des paramètres et des résultats des fonctions
declare(strict_types=1);

// espace de noms des tests
namespace Application\Tests;

// les classes testées
use Application\ClientDao;
use Application\ClientMetier;
use Application\ExceptionImpots;
use Application\InterfaceClientMetier;
use Application\Simulation;
// les classes de PHPUnit
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\DataProvider;
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

// test de la couche [métier] du client du service web JSON : le serveur doit être lancé
final class ClientMetierTest extends TestCase
{
    // le dossier racine du client
    private const string ROOT_DIRECTORY = __DIR__ . "/..";
    // la configuration du client
    private static array $config;
    // la couche [métier] testée
    private InterfaceClientMetier $métier;

    // exécutée une fois, avant le premier test de la classe
    #[\Override]
    public static function setUpBeforeClass(): void
    {
        // on récupère la configuration du client
        self::$config = json_decode(file_get_contents(self::ROOT_DIRECTORY . "/Data/config.json"), true, flags: JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);
        // on inclut les dépendances du client (le chargeur de Composer est déjà chargé par PHPUnit)
        foreach (self::$config["dependencies"] as $dependency) {
            require_once self::ROOT_DIRECTORY . "/$dependency";
        }
    }

    // exécutée avant chaque test : chaque test a sa propre session JSON authentifiée
    #[\Override]
    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        // création des couches [dao] (non verbeuse) et [métier]
        $clientDao = new ClientDao(self::$config["urlServer"], self::$config["httpClientOptions"], verbose: false);
        $this->métier = new ClientMetier($clientDao);
        // initialisation d'une session JSON
        $this->métier->initSession("json");
        // authentification
        $this->métier->authentifierUtilisateur(self::$config["user"]["login"], self::$config["user"]["passwd"]);
    }

    // les contribuables du tableau des chiffres officiels
    public static function contribuables(): array
    {
        // [marié, enfants, salaire, impôt officiel, [impôt, surcôte, décôte, réduction, taux] attendus]
        return [
            "couple, 2 enfants, 55555" => ["oui", 2, 55555, 2815, [2814, 0, 0, 0, 0.14]],
            "couple, 2 enfants, 50000" => ["oui", 2, 50000, 1385, [1384, 0, 384, 347, 0.14]],
            "couple, 3 enfants, 50000" => ["oui", 3, 50000, 0, [0, 0, 720, 0, 0.14]],
            "célibataire, 2 enfants, 100000" => ["non", 2, 100000, 19884, [19884, 4480, 0, 0, 0.41]],
            "célibataire, 3 enfants, 100000" => ["non", 3, 100000, 16782, [16782, 7176, 0, 0, 0.41]],
            "couple, 3 enfants, 100000" => ["oui", 3, 100000, 9200, [9200, 2180, 0, 0, 0.3]],
            "couple, 5 enfants, 100000" => ["oui", 5, 100000, 4230, [4230, 0, 0, 0, 0.14]],
            "célibataire, 0 enfant, 100000" => ["non", 0, 100000, 22986, [22986, 0, 0, 0, 0.41]],
            "couple, 2 enfants, 30000" => ["oui", 2, 30000, 0, [0, 0, 0, 0, 0.0]],
            "célibataire, 0 enfant, 200000" => ["non", 0, 200000, 64211, [64210, 7498, 0, 0, 0.45]],
            "couple, 3 enfants, 200000" => ["oui", 3, 200000, 42843, [42842, 17283, 0, 0, 0.41]],
        ];
    }

    // un test exécuté une fois pour chacun des contribuables du fournisseur de données
    #[DataProvider("contribuables")]
    public function testCalculerImpot(string $marié, int $enfants, int $salaire, int $impôtOfficiel, array $attendu): void
    {
        // calcul de l'impôt
        $simulation = $this->métier->calculerImpot($marié, $enfants, $salaire);
        // l'impôt est celui du simulateur officiel à 1 euro près
        $this->assertEqualsWithDelta($impôtOfficiel, $simulation->impôt, 1);
        // la simulation est exactement celle attendue : [assertEquals] compare les attributs des deux objets
        $this->assertEquals(new Simulation($marié, $enfants, $salaire, ...$attendu), $simulation);
    }

    // les actions [lister-simulations] et [supprimer-simulation]
    public function testListerSupprimerSimulations(): void
    {
        // deux simulations dans une session neuve
        $this->métier->calculerImpot("oui", 2, 55555);
        $this->métier->calculerImpot("non", 0, 100000);
        $this->assertCount(2, $this->métier->listerSimulations());
        // suppression de la 1re : il reste la seconde
        $simulations = $this->métier->supprimerSimulation(0);
        $this->assertCount(1, $simulations);
        $this->assertSame(22986, $simulations[0]->impôt);
        // la simulation n° 1 n'existe plus : état 628, statut HTTP 400
        $this->assertErreur(400, 628, fn() => $this->métier->supprimerSimulation(1));
    }

    // après la fin de session, l'utilisateur n'est plus authentifié
    public function testFinSession(): void
    {
        $this->métier->finSession();
        // état 104 : action demandée par un utilisateur non authentifié
        $this->assertErreur(400, 104, fn() => $this->métier->listerSimulations());
    }

    // vérifie que l'action [$action] lance une exception [ExceptionImpots] de code 42
    // dont le message JSON contient le statut HTTP et l'état attendus
    private function assertErreur(int $statutHttp, int $état, \Closure $action): void
    {
        try {
            $action();
            $this->fail("une exception [ExceptionImpots] était attendue");
        } catch (ExceptionImpots $ex) {
            $this->assertSame(42, $ex->getCode());
            $erreur = json_decode($ex->getMessage(), true, flags: JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);
            $this->assertSame($statutHttp, $erreur["statut HTTP"]);
            $this->assertSame($état, $erreur["état"]);
        }
    }
}

Comments

  • lines 31-37: the client's configuration is read and the dependencies loaded only once, before the 1st test;
  • lines 43-51: remember that the [setUp] method is executed before each test. It builds the [dao] (in non-verbose mode) and [métier] layers, then initializes a JSON session and authenticates. Each test thus works in its own session, without depending on the other tests. The PHP 7 course did this work in the constructor of the test class, which PHPUnit no longer allows;
  • lines 55-69: the data provider of the previous versions. For each taxpayer, we have the tax from the official simulator and the five expected results [impôt, surcôte, décôte, réduction, taux];
  • line 82: we build the expected simulation and compare it with the one returned by the server. Applied to two objects, the [assertEquals] method checks that they are of the same class and that their attributes are equal. The [...] operator unpacks a list here: its elements are passed to the last five parameters of the constructor, in order;
  • lines 86-97: a test of the [lister-simulations] and [supprimer-simulation] actions. We perform two simulations, delete the 1st and check that the second remains. Then we request the deletion of a simulation that does not exist: the server must respond with state 628;
  • lines 101-105: after the end of the session, the list of simulations must be refused with state 104;
  • lines 110-119: a utility method that checks that the action [$action], passed in the form of an anonymous function, throws an [ExceptionImpots] exception with code 42 with the expected HTTP status and state. Since the exception message is the server's JSON response, we decode it to check its elements. If no exception is thrown, the [fail] method makes the test fail.

The test results are as follows:

> php vendor/bin/phpunit scripts-console/impots/version-12/Tests --testdox
PHPUnit 12.5.37 by Sebastian Bergmann and contributors.

Runtime:       PHP 8.5.11
Configuration: .../php8-oct-2026/phpunit.xml

.............                                                     13 / 13 (100%)

Time: 00:00.195, Memory: 16.00 MB

Client Metier (Application\Tests\ClientMetier)
 ✔ Calculer impot with data set "couple, 2 enfants, 55555"
 ✔ Calculer impot with data set "couple, 2 enfants, 50000"
 ✔ Calculer impot with data set "couple, 3 enfants, 50000"
 ✔ Calculer impot with data set "célibataire, 2 enfants, 100000"
 ✔ Calculer impot with data set "célibataire, 3 enfants, 100000"
 ✔ Calculer impot with data set "couple, 3 enfants, 100000"
 ✔ Calculer impot with data set "couple, 5 enfants, 100000"
 ✔ Calculer impot with data set "célibataire, 0 enfant, 100000"
 ✔ Calculer impot with data set "couple, 2 enfants, 30000"
 ✔ Calculer impot with data set "célibataire, 0 enfant, 200000"
 ✔ Calculer impot with data set "couple, 3 enfants, 200000"
 ✔ Lister supprimer simulations
 ✔ Fin session

OK (13 tests, 31 assertions)

Many other tests should be done:

  • test the various methods of the [dao] layer;
  • test the states returned by the web server. These states are important since their value decides which HTML page is displayed.

docs.title: 24. Application exercise – version 13
docs.text: Version 13 brings few changes: it secures access to the application's files. It adds no functionality: the actions, the JSON, XML and HTML responses and the views are those of version 12. What changes is the organization of the files on disk and the configuration of the [Apache] server.

docs.title: 24.1. The problem
docs.text:
In the PHP 7 course, one could request the URL of the version 12 configuration file and the browser would display it. Yet this [config.json] file contains sensitive information, such as the credentials of the users authorized to use the application. It must not be accessible to users.

In our version 12, this file is already protected: it is in the [Data] folder, whose [.htaccess] file, presented with version 8, forbids access to it (directive [Require all denied]). But this is case-by-case protection: we forbid what we thought of forbidding, and everything else is served. And there are still many things that should not be shown. For example, the browser can request a view directly, without going through the main controller:

> curl -i http://localhost/php8-oct-2026/scripts-web/impots/version-12/Views/vue-calcul-impot.php
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Server: Apache/2.4.58
X-Powered-By: PHP/8.5.11
Vary: Accept-Encoding
Content-Length: 1011
Content-Type: text/html; charset=UTF-8

<br />
<b>Warning</b>:  Undefined variable $request in <b>.../php8-oct-2026/scripts-web/impots/version-12/Views/vue-calcul-impot.php</b> on line <b>9</b><br />
<br />
<b>Warning</b>:  Undefined variable $content in <b>.../php8-oct-2026/scripts-web/impots/version-12/Views/vue-calcul-impot.php</b> on line <b>9</b><br />
<br />
<b>Fatal error</b>:  Uncaught TypeError: getModelForThisView(): Argument #1 ($request) must be of type Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\Request, null given, called in .../php8-oct-2026/scripts-web/impots/version-12/Views/vue-calcul-impot.php on line 9 and defined in .../php8-oct-2026/scripts-web/impots/version-12/Views/vue-calcul-impot.php:11
Stack trace:
#0 .../php8-oct-2026/scripts-web/impots/version-12/Views/vue-calcul-impot.php(9): getModelForThisView(NULL, NULL)
#1 {main}
  thrown in <b>.../php8-oct-2026/scripts-web/impots/version-12/Views/vue-calcul-impot.php</b> on line <b>11</b><br />

The view is executed out of its context: the variables normally provided to it by the [HtmlResponse] class do not exist. Since [Laragon] is configured for development (PHP's [display_errors=On] directive), the error messages are sent to the browser. They reveal the path of the files on the server, the names of the functions and classes used: all of it useful information for anyone wishing to attack the application. The secondary controllers, the response classes, and the classes of the [métier] and [dao] layers can likewise be executed through a simple URL. Here, they only define a class, but nothing guarantees it will always be so.

Worse: the entire [php8-oct-2026] folder of the course is in [Laragon]'s [www] folder. The files of the console scripts are also accessible through the web, even though no one thought of protecting them:

> curl -i http://localhost/php8-oct-2026/scripts-console/impots/version-05/Data/database.json
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Server: Apache/2.4.58
Last-Modified: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 15:46:08 GMT

Anyone can read the login and password of the user of the [dbimpots-2019] database. Yet versions 8 to 12 of the server use this file or its equivalent.

The right approach is the reverse: forbid everything, then explicitly allow what must be accessible from the outside. For our application, only three files must be:

  • [main.php], the main controller, which receives all requests;
  • [index.php], the entry point of the HTML application, which redirects to [main.php];
  • the image [logo.jpg], which the browser requests with an HTTP request when it displays the views' banner.

docs.title: 24.2. The new folder structure
docs.text:
We copy and paste the [scripts-web/impots/version-12] folder into [scripts-web/impots/version-13], then reorganize its files:

scripts-web/impots/version-13
├── .htaccess
├── Config
│   ├── config.json
│   ├── database.json
│   └── vhost-impots-v13.conf
├── Controllers
│   └── (les contrôleurs secondaires de la version 12)
├── Entities
│   ├── Action.php
│   ├── ControllerResult.php
│   ├── Database.php
│   ├── ExceptionImpots.php
│   ├── ResponseType.php
│   ├── Simulation.php
│   └── TaxAdminData.php
├── Logs
│   └── logs.txt
├── Model
│   ├── InterfaceServerDao.php
│   ├── InterfaceServerMetier.php
│   ├── ServerDao.php
│   ├── ServerDaoWithSession.php
│   └── ServerMetier.php
├── Responses
│   └── (les classes des réponses de la version 12)
├── Utilities
│   ├── Logger.php
│   ├── SendAdminMail.php
│   ├── Utilitaires.php
│   └── XmlUtilitaires.php
├── Views
│   └── (les vues de la version 12, sans le logo)
└── public
    ├── Resources
    │   └── logo.jpg
    ├── index.php
    └── main.php
  • in [public], the only folder that will be accessible through the web. It contains the two scripts [index.php, main.php] and, in the [Resources] folder, the image [logo.jpg]. The name [public] is the one used by current PHP frameworks (Symfony, Laravel) for this same role;
  • in [Config], the configuration files: [config.json] (the former [Data/config.json]) and [database.json], the database configuration that was taken from the [Data] folder of version 8. The [vhost-impots-v13.conf] file will be presented at the end of the chapter;
  • in [Logs], the log file, which was in the [Data] folder;
  • in [Model], the classes of the server's [métier] and [dao] layers. Until now, they were loaded from the folders of versions 8 and 9. They are now copied into the version 13 folder, as are the entities [ExceptionImpots, TaxAdminData, Database] (version 5) and the utilities [Logger, SendAdminMail] (version 9), [XmlUtilitaires] (version 11) and [Utilitaires] (version 5). The [version-13] folder thus contains the whole application: it alone is what would be copied to a production server, without depending on the folders of the other versions;
  • the [Tests] folder of version 12, which contained the test pages of the views, is not carried over: these pages would no longer be accessible through the web anyway.

The names of these files do not change, and neither does their content, with three exceptions that we now present. Only Composer's [vendor] library stays where it is, at the root of the [php8-oct-2026] folder.

docs.title: 24.3.2. The main controller [public/main.php]
docs.text:
The main controller is moved to the [public] folder. Only two lines change:

// les erreurs de PHP ne sont pas envoyées au client (elles vont dans le journal du serveur web)
ini_set("display_errors", "0");

// le dossier racine de l'application, parent du dossier [public] : les chemins du fichier de configuration sont relatifs à ce dossier
const ROOT_DIRECTORY = __DIR__ . "/..";
// chemin du fichier de configuration
const CONFIG_FILENAME = ROOT_DIRECTORY . "/Config/config.json";

// l'autoloader de Composer (Symfony, Predis)
require_once ROOT_DIRECTORY . "/../../../vendor/autoload.php";
  • line 18: the [ROOT_DIRECTORY] constant still designates the application's root folder, to which the paths in the [config.json] file are relative. Since the script is now in the [public] folder, this root folder is the parent folder of [__DIR__]. We cannot write [dirname(__DIR__)]: the value of a constant declared with [const] must be a constant expression, and a function call is not one. The concatenation of [__DIR__] (a constant) and a string is one;
  • line 20: the new path of the configuration file;
  • line 23: this line does not change: the path of Composer's autoloader is relative to the application's root folder, which is still [scripts-web/impots/version-13].

The [public/index.php] script is the one from version 12. Its redirection to the relative URL [main.php?action=init-session&type=html] remains correct since [index.php] and [main.php] are in the same folder.

docs.title: 24.3.3. The views' banner

        </div>
