Perte de la connexion avec le serveur...
Fin du client
  • [A1 LOGIN guest@localhost guest]: the [LOGIN utilisateur motdepasse] command authenticates the user. The server replies with the list of its capabilities (CAPABILITY);
  • [A2 SELECT INBOX]: the [SELECT] command chooses the mailbox to which the following commands will apply. The server indicates the possible flags (FLAGS), the number of messages (2 EXISTS), the number of the first unread message (UNSEEN 1)...;
  • [A3 SEARCH UNSEEN]: the [SEARCH] command searches for messages according to a criterion. There are a good twenty of them. Here, we are looking for messages that have not yet been read (UNSEEN). The server returns their numbers: 1 and 2;
  • [A4 FETCH 2 (...)]: the [FETCH] command requests information about a message. Here, its flags (FLAGS), its size (RFC822.SIZE) and four of its headers. The [BODY.PEEK[...]] form requests part of the message without marking it as read. The text of the headers is sent in the form of a literal: [{114}] at the end of the line announces that the next 114 bytes are part of the response, whatever their content (end-of-line characters in particular). The response ends with a closing parenthesis after the literal;
  • [A5 FETCH 2 BODY.PEEK[1.1]]: we request part no. 1.1 of message no. 2, here its [text/plain] text. We will soon see how the parts of a message are numbered;
  • [A6 FETCH 1 BODYSTRUCTURE]: we request the structure of message no. 1, the one with five attachments. The response is a list of lists in parentheses. We recognize in it the parts of the message we saw in [Mailpit]: a list [(("text" "plain" ...)("text" "html" ...) "alternative" ...)] for the [multipart/alternative] part, then one list per attachment, with its type, its parameters (name), its encoding (base64), its size, its disposition ("attachment" with the file name). The structure ends with the [mixed] subtype of the whole message;
  • [A7 LOGOUT]: the end of the dialogue.

docs.title: 16.6.5. Classes for the POP3 and IMAP protocols
docs.text:
Our email-reading scripts will use either a POP3 server or an IMAP server interchangeably. We are therefore going to write:

  • a [ClientMessagerie] interface describing what an email-reading client can do;
  • an abstract class [ClientTcp] grouping what is common to the two protocols: a TCP connection, possibly encrypted, over which lines of text are exchanged;
  • two classes [Pop3Client] and [ImapClient] that inherit from [ClientTcp] and implement the [ClientMessagerie] interface;
  • a [PartieMime] class describing the structure of a message, obtained with the IMAP [BODYSTRUCTURE] command.

They are in the [inet/imap] folder:

imap
├── ClientMessagerie.php
├── ClientTcp.php
├── ImapClient.php
├── PartieMime.php
├── Pop3Client.php
├── config-imap-01.json
├── config-pop3-01.json
├── imap-01.php
├── imap-02.php
├── imap-03.php
└── pop3-01.php

docs.title: 16.6.5.1. The [ClientMessagerie] interface
docs.text:
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

// ce que sait faire un client de lecture du courrier, qu'il parle POP3 ou IMAP
// les messages sont désignés par leur n° (1, 2...) dans la boîte à lettres
interface ClientMessagerie
{
    // connexion et authentification - rend le nombre de messages de la boîte à lettres
    public function connecter(): int;

    // les n°s des messages non lus
    public function nonLus(): array;

    // les entêtes principaux du message n° $n (Date, From, To, Subject...)
    public function entêtes(int $n): array;

    // le texte complet du message n° $n (entêtes et corps)
    public function message(int $n): string;

    // marque le message n° $n comme « à supprimer »
    public function supprimer(int $n): void;

    // supprime les messages marqués et ferme la connexion
    public function fermer(): void;
}
  • line 10: connecting to the server and authenticating the user. The method returns the number of messages in the mailbox;
  • line 13: the numbers of the unread messages;
  • line 16: the main headers of a message, in the form of a dictionary;
  • line 19: the full text of a message, i.e. what we saw in [Mailpit]'s [Raw] tab;
  • line 22: marks a message as "to be deleted";
  • line 25: deletes the marked messages and closes the connection.

docs.title: 16.6.5.2. The [ClientTcp] class
docs.text:
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

// classe de base des clients POP3 et IMAP : une connexion TCP, éventuellement
// chiffrée (TLS), sur laquelle on échange des lignes de texte terminées par \r\n
abstract class ClientTcp
{
    // la connexion avec le serveur (une ressource de type stream)
    protected mixed $connexion = null;

    // $infos : la configuration du serveur (server, port, tls, verify-peer, user, password...)
    // $suivi : si true, les échanges client / serveur sont affichés sur la console
    public function __construct(protected readonly array $infos, protected readonly bool $suivi = false)
    {
    }

    // ouverture de la connexion avec le serveur
    protected function ouvrirConnexion(): void
    {
        // connexion chiffrée dès son ouverture (tls://) ou non (tcp://) ?
        $transport = ($this->infos["tls"] ?? false) ? "tls" : "tcp";
        // faut-il vérifier le certificat du serveur ? (oui par défaut)
        $vérifier = $this->infos["verify-peer"] ?? true;
        $contexte = stream_context_create(["ssl" => ["verify_peer" => $vérifier, "verify_peer_name" => $vérifier]]);
        $connexion = @stream_socket_client("$transport://{$this->infos["server"]}:{$this->infos["port"]}",
            $numErreur, $erreur, 10, STREAM_CLIENT_CONNECT, $contexte);
        if ($connexion === false) {
            throw new RuntimeException("échec de la connexion au serveur "
                . "[{$this->infos["server"]}:{$this->infos["port"]}] : $erreur");
        }
        $this->connexion = $connexion;
    }

    // envoi d'une ligne au serveur - $affichage : ce qu'il faut afficher en mode suivi
    protected function envoyer(string $ligne, ?string $affichage = null): void
    {
        fwrite($this->connexion, "$ligne\r\n");
        $this->afficher("--> " . ($affichage ?? $ligne));
    }

    // lecture d'une ligne envoyée par le serveur, rendue sans les caractères \r\n
    // $afficher : faut-il afficher la ligne en mode suivi ?
    protected function lireLigne(bool $afficher = true): string
    {
        $ligne = fgets($this->connexion);
        if ($ligne === false) {
            throw new RuntimeException("le serveur a fermé la connexion");
        }
        $ligne = rtrim($ligne, "\r\n");
        if ($afficher) {
            $this->afficher("<-- $ligne");
        }
        return $ligne;
    }

    // lecture de $nbOctets octets envoyés par le serveur
    protected function lireOctets(int $nbOctets): string
    {
        $octets = "";
        while (strlen($octets) < $nbOctets) {
            $morceau = fread($this->connexion, $nbOctets - strlen($octets));
            if ($morceau === false || $morceau === "") {
                throw new RuntimeException("le serveur a fermé la connexion");
            }
            $octets .= $morceau;
        }
        $this->afficher("<-- ... $nbOctets octets ...");
        return $octets;
    }

    // fermeture de la connexion
    protected function fermerConnexion(): void
    {
        if ($this->connexion !== null) {
            fclose($this->connexion);
            $this->connexion = null;
        }
    }

    // affichage en mode suivi
    protected function afficher(string $message): void
    {
        if ($this->suivi) {
            print "$message\n";
        }
    }

    // analyse des entêtes d'un message : rend le dictionnaire [nom => valeur] des entêtes
    // décodés (les entêtes non ASCII sont codés, par exemple =?utf-8?Q?...?=)
    protected static function analyserEntêtes(string $entêtes): array
    {
        $dictionnaire = iconv_mime_decode_headers($entêtes, ICONV_MIME_DECODE_CONTINUE_ON_ERROR, "UTF-8");
        return $dictionnaire === false ? [] : $dictionnaire;
    }
}
  • line 7: the class is abstract: it cannot be instantiated. It serves as the parent class of the [Pop3Client] and [ImapClient] classes;
  • line 10: the connection with the server. PHP's functions represent it by a resource, a type that PHP does not allow to be declared: we use the [mixed] type;
  • line 14: the constructor uses constructor property promotion (PHP 8.0): the [$infos] and [$suivi] parameters become properties of the class, here read-only ([readonly], PHP 8.1). The constructor body is empty. [$infos] is the server configuration, read from a JSON file. [$suivi] requests that the client / server exchanges be displayed;
  • lines 19-32: opening the connection. If the configuration contains [tls: true], the connection is encrypted from the moment it is opened ([tls://] transport). The context specifies whether the server's certificate must be verified ([verify-peer] entry, true by default);
  • line 36: sending a line to the server. The [$affichage] parameter makes it possible to display something other than what is sent: we will use it to avoid displaying passwords;
  • line 44: reading a line. If the server has closed the connection, an exception is thrown;
  • line 58: reading a given number of bytes. We will use it for IMAP literals. The [fread] function may return fewer bytes than requested: we loop until everything has been received;
  • line 91: the [iconv_mime_decode_headers] function parses a block of email headers and returns the [nom => valeur] dictionary. It rejoins headers written over several lines and decodes encoded headers (=?utf-8?Q?...?=).

docs.title: 16.6.5.3. The [Pop3Client] class
docs.text:
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

require_once __DIR__ . "/ClientTcp.php";
require_once __DIR__ . "/ClientMessagerie.php";

// client POP3 : les commandes USER, PASS, STAT, TOP, LIST, RETR, DELE, QUIT
final class Pop3Client extends ClientTcp implements ClientMessagerie
{
    // nombre de messages de la boîte à lettres
    private int $nbMessages = 0;

    #[\Override]
    public function connecter(): int
    {
        $this->ouvrirConnexion();
        // message de bienvenue du serveur
        $this->commande("");
        // authentification
        $this->commande("USER {$this->infos["user"]}");
        $this->commande("PASS {$this->infos["password"]}", "PASS *****");
        // STAT : la réponse a la forme [+OK nbMessages tailleTotale]
        $réponse = $this->commande("STAT");
        $this->nbMessages = (int) explode(" ", $réponse[0])[1];
        return $this->nbMessages;
    }

    #[\Override]
    public function nonLus(): array
    {
        // POP3 ne mémorise pas les messages lus : tous les messages présents sont nouveaux
        return $this->nbMessages === 0 ? [] : range(1, $this->nbMessages);
    }

    #[\Override]
    public function entêtes(int $n): array
    {
        // TOP n 0 : les entêtes du message n° n suivis de 0 ligne du corps
        $lignes = $this->commande("TOP $n 0", multiligne: true);
        $entêtes = self::analyserEntêtes(implode("\r\n", array_slice($lignes, 1)));
        // LIST n : la réponse a la forme [+OK n taille]
        $réponse = $this->commande("LIST $n");
        // on ne garde que les principaux entêtes
        $résumé = array_intersect_key($entêtes, array_flip(["Date", "From", "To", "Subject", "Message-ID"]));
        return [...$résumé, "Size" => explode(" ", $réponse[0])[2]];
    }

    #[\Override]
    public function message(int $n): string
    {
        // RETR n : la 1re ligne de la réponse est [+OK...], les suivantes le message
        $lignes = $this->commande("RETR $n", multiligne: true);
        return implode("\r\n", array_slice($lignes, 1)) . "\r\n";
    }

    #[\Override]
    public function supprimer(int $n): void
    {
        $this->commande("DELE $n");
    }

    #[\Override]
    public function fermer(): void
    {
        // rien à faire si la connexion n'a pas pu être ouverte
        if ($this->connexion === null) {
            return;
        }
        try {
            // c'est la commande QUIT qui fait supprimer les messages marqués par DELE
            $this->commande("QUIT");
        } finally {
            $this->fermerConnexion();
        }
    }

    // envoie une commande au serveur (si elle n'est pas vide) et rend les lignes de la réponse
    // $multiligne : la réponse se termine-t-elle par une ligne réduite à un point ?
    private function commande(string $commande, ?string $affichage = null, bool $multiligne = false): array
    {
        if ($commande !== "") {
            $this->envoyer($commande, $affichage);
        }
        // 1re ligne : +OK ou -ERR
        $ligne = $this->lireLigne();
        if (str_starts_with($ligne, "-ERR")) {
            throw new RuntimeException("[" . ($affichage ?? $commande) . "] : $ligne");
        }
        $réponse = [$ligne];
        if ($multiligne) {
            // les lignes suivantes, jusqu'à la ligne [.], ne sont pas affichées en mode suivi
            while (($ligne = $this->lireLigne(false)) !== ".") {
                // le serveur double le point qui commence une ligne : on l'enlève
                $réponse[] = str_starts_with($ligne, "..") ? substr($ligne, 1) : $ligne;
            }
            $this->afficher("<-- ... " . (count($réponse) - 1) . " lignes ...");
            $this->afficher("<-- .");
        }
        return $réponse;
    }
}
  • line 9: the class inherits from [ClientTcp] and implements [ClientMessagerie]. It is declared [final]: no class can be derived from it;
  • line 14: the [#[\Override]] attribute (PHP 8.3) indicates that the method implements a method of an interface or overrides that of a parent class. If this is not the case (a typo in the name, for example), PHP reports an error;
  • lines 15-26: the connection. We find the commands of [pop3-01.php]. The [STAT] command returns the number of messages and their total size on a single line. The password is displayed in the form [*****];
  • lines 30-33: the POP3 protocol does not remember which messages have been read: all the messages present are considered new. The [range(1, n)] function returns the array [1, 2, ..., n];
  • lines 37-46: the [TOP n 0] command returns the headers of message no. n followed by 0 lines of its body. The [LIST n] command returns its size. The [array_intersect_key] function keeps only the headers whose name is a key of the array returned by [array_flip]. The [...] operator copies these headers into the returned array, to which the size is added;
  • lines 50-54: the [RETR n] command returns message no. n;
  • lines 64-74: the [QUIT] command causes the messages marked by the [DELE] command to be deleted. The connection is closed in all cases ([finally] block);
  • line 80: the [commande] method is the [sendCommand] function of [pop3-01.php]. In tracing mode, the lines of a multiline response are not displayed: only their count is.

docs.title: 16.6.5.4. The [ImapClient] class
docs.text:
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

require_once __DIR__ . "/ClientTcp.php";
require_once __DIR__ . "/ClientMessagerie.php";
require_once __DIR__ . "/PartieMime.php";

// client IMAP : les commandes LOGIN, SELECT, SEARCH, FETCH, STORE, EXPUNGE, LOGOUT
// chaque commande est précédée d'une étiquette (A0001, A0002...) ; le serveur envoie
// des réponses [* ...] puis termine par une réponse [étiquette OK|NO|BAD ...]
final class ImapClient extends ClientTcp implements ClientMessagerie
{
    // n° de la dernière commande envoyée (sert à fabriquer les étiquettes)
    private int $numéro = 0;
    // y a-t-il des messages marqués « à supprimer » ?
    private bool $suppressions = false;

    #[\Override]
    public function connecter(): int
    {
        $this->ouvrirConnexion();
        // message de bienvenue du serveur : [* OK ...]
        [$bienvenue] = $this->lireRéponse();
        if (!str_starts_with($bienvenue, "* OK")) {
            throw new RuntimeException("le serveur refuse la connexion : $bienvenue");
        }
        // authentification
        $this->commande("LOGIN " . self::chaîne($this->infos["user"]) . " " . self::chaîne($this->infos["password"]),
            "LOGIN " . self::chaîne($this->infos["user"]) . " *****");
        // sélection de la boîte à lettres : une des réponses a la forme [* n EXISTS]
        $réponses = $this->commande("SELECT " . self::chaîne($this->infos["mailbox"] ?? "INBOX"));
        $exists = array_find($réponses, fn(array $réponse): bool => ($réponse[1] ?? "") === "EXISTS");
        return (int) ($exists[0] ?? 0);
    }

    #[\Override]
    public function nonLus(): array
    {
        // la réponse a la forme [* SEARCH n1 n2 ...]
        $réponses = $this->commande("SEARCH UNSEEN");
        $search = array_find($réponses, fn(array $réponse): bool => $réponse[0] === "SEARCH") ?? ["SEARCH"];
        return array_map(intval(...), array_slice($search, 1));
    }

    #[\Override]
    public function entêtes(int $n): array
    {
        // BODY.PEEK[HEADER] : les entêtes du message, sans le marquer comme lu
        $données = $this->fetch($n, "(FLAGS RFC822.SIZE BODY.PEEK[HEADER])");
        $entêtes = self::analyserEntêtes($données["BODY[HEADER]"]);
        // on ne garde que les principaux entêtes
        $résumé = array_intersect_key($entêtes, array_flip(["Date", "From", "To", "Subject", "Message-ID"]));
        return [...$résumé, "Flags" => implode(" ", $données["FLAGS"]), "Size" => $données["RFC822.SIZE"]];
    }

    #[\Override]
    public function message(int $n): string
    {
        // BODY[] : le message entier ; le serveur le marque comme lu (drapeau \Seen)
        return $this->fetch($n, "BODY[]")["BODY[]"];
    }

    // la structure MIME du message n° $n
    public function structure(int $n): PartieMime
    {
        return PartieMime::depuisBodyStructure($this->fetch($n, "BODYSTRUCTURE")["BODYSTRUCTURE"]);
    }

    // le contenu (encodé) de la partie n° $section (1, 1.2...) du message n° $n
    public function partie(int $n, string $section): string
    {
        return $this->fetch($n, "BODY[$section]")["BODY[$section]"] ?? "";
    }

    #[\Override]
    public function supprimer(int $n): void
    {
        // on ajoute le drapeau \Deleted au message
        $this->commande("STORE $n +FLAGS (\\Deleted)");
        $this->suppressions = true;
    }

    #[\Override]
    public function fermer(): void
    {
        // rien à faire si la connexion n'a pas pu être ouverte
        if ($this->connexion === null) {
            return;
        }
        try {
            // EXPUNGE supprime les messages qui ont le drapeau \Deleted
            if ($this->suppressions) {
                $this->commande("EXPUNGE");
            }
            $this->commande("LOGOUT");
        } finally {
            $this->fermerConnexion();
        }
    }

    // commande FETCH n éléments : rend le dictionnaire [élément => valeur] de la réponse
    // [* n FETCH (élément1 valeur1 élément2 valeur2 ...)]
    private function fetch(int $n, string $éléments): array
    {
        $réponses = $this->commande("FETCH $n $éléments");
        $fetch = array_find($réponses, fn(array $réponse): bool => ($réponse[1] ?? "") === "FETCH");
        if ($fetch === null) {
            throw new RuntimeException("pas de message n° $n");
        }
        $dictionnaire = [];
        foreach (array_chunk($fetch[2], 2) as [$clé, $valeur]) {
            $dictionnaire[strtoupper($clé)] = $valeur;
        }
        return $dictionnaire;
    }

    // envoie une commande étiquetée et rend ses réponses [* ...], chacune découpée en jetons
    // $affichage : ce qu'il faut afficher en mode suivi (pour cacher un mot de passe)
    private function commande(string $commande, ?string $affichage = null): array
    {
        $étiquette = sprintf("A%04d", ++$this->numéro);
        $this->envoyer("$étiquette $commande", $affichage === null ? null : "$étiquette $affichage");
        $réponses = [];
        while (true) {
            [$texte, $littéraux] = $this->lireRéponse();
            // réponse finale [étiquette OK|NO|BAD texte] ?
            if (str_starts_with($texte, "$étiquette ")) {
                $statut = substr($texte, strlen($étiquette) + 1);
                if (!str_starts_with($statut, "OK")) {
                    throw new RuntimeException("[" . ($affichage ?? $commande) . "] : $statut");
                }
                return $réponses;
            }
            // réponse [* ...]
            if (str_starts_with($texte, "* ")) {
                $position = 2;
                $réponses[] = self::jetons($texte, $position, $littéraux);
            }
        }
    }

    // lit une réponse du serveur : une ligne qui peut contenir des littéraux. Un littéral
    // est annoncé par {n} en fin de ligne : suivent n octets, puis la suite de la ligne.
    // rend le texte de la réponse, où le littéral n° k est remplacé par \0k\0, et les littéraux
    private function lireRéponse(): array
    {
        $texte = "";
        $littéraux = [];
        while (true) {
            $ligne = $this->lireLigne();
            if (preg_match('/\{(\d+)\}$/', $ligne, $champs) !== 1) {
                return [$texte . $ligne, $littéraux];
            }
            $texte .= substr($ligne, 0, -strlen($champs[0])) . "\0" . count($littéraux) . "\0";
            $littéraux[] = $this->lireOctets((int) $champs[1]);
        }
    }

    // découpe $texte en jetons à partir de la position $position, jusqu'à la fin du texte ou
    // jusqu'à une parenthèse fermante. Une liste (...) devient un tableau, NIL devient null,
    // une chaîne "..." ou un littéral devient une chaîne, tout le reste (atome) aussi
    private static function jetons(string $texte, int &$position, array $littéraux): array
    {
        $jetons = [];
        $longueur = strlen($texte);
        while ($position < $longueur) {
            $c = $texte[$position];
            if ($c === " ") {
                $position++;
            } elseif ($c === "(") {
                // une liste : appel récursif
                $position++;
                $jetons[] = self::jetons($texte, $position, $littéraux);
            } elseif ($c === ")") {
                // fin de la liste en cours
                $position++;
                return $jetons;
            } elseif ($c === '"') {
                // une chaîne entre guillemets où \" et \\ représentent " et \
                $chaîne = "";
                for ($position++; $texte[$position] !== '"'; $position++) {
                    if ($texte[$position] === "\\") {
                        $position++;
                    }
                    $chaîne .= $texte[$position];
                }
                $position++;
                $jetons[] = $chaîne;
            } elseif ($c === "\0") {
                // un littéral
                $fin = strpos($texte, "\0", $position + 1);
                $jetons[] = $littéraux[(int) substr($texte, $position + 1, $fin - $position - 1)];
                $position = $fin + 1;
            } else {
                // un atome : jusqu'au prochain espace ou parenthèse, sauf entre crochets
                // (BODY[HEADER.FIELDS (FROM TO)] est un seul atome)
                $début = $position;
                $crochets = 0;
                while ($position < $longueur
                    && ($crochets > 0 || !in_array($texte[$position], [" ", "(", ")"], true))) {
                    $crochets += match ($texte[$position]) { "[" => 1, "]" => -1, default => 0 };
                    $position++;
                }
                $atome = substr($texte, $début, $position - $début);
                $jetons[] = $atome === "NIL" ? null : $atome;
            }
        }
        return $jetons;
    }

    // une chaîne IMAP : entre guillemets, avec \ devant les caractères " et \
    private static function chaîne(string $texte): string
    {
        return '"' . addcslashes($texte, '"\\') . '"';
    }
}
  • line 15: the number of the last command. It is used to build the tags [A0001], [A0002]...;
  • lines 20-34: the connection. The server first sends a welcome message [* OK ...]. We then send the [LOGIN] and [SELECT] commands. The [commande] method returns the server's [* ...] responses, each split into tokens: the response [* 2 EXISTS] becomes the array [["2", "EXISTS"]]. The [array_find] function (PHP 8.4) returns the first element of the array that satisfies the condition, or [null];
  • lines 38-43: the [SEARCH UNSEEN] command. The response [* SEARCH 1 2] becomes [["SEARCH", "1", "2"]]. We keep its elements from no. 1 onwards ([array_slice]), converted to integers by the [intval] function. The notation [intval(...)] (PHP 8.1) creates a function from the [intval] function: this is the first-class callable syntax;
  • lines 47-54: the [FETCH n (FLAGS RFC822.SIZE BODY.PEEK[HEADER])] command returns the flags, the size and the headers of message no. n;
  • lines 58-61: the [FETCH n BODY[]] command returns message no. n in full. The server adds the [\Seen] flag to it: the message is now read;
  • lines 65-67: the [FETCH n BODYSTRUCTURE] command returns the structure of the message, which the [PartieMime] class turns into a tree of objects;
  • lines 71-73: the [FETCH n BODY[section]] command returns the content of part no. [section] of the message, as it is encoded in the message (base64, quoted-printable...);
  • lines 77-81: the [STORE n +FLAGS (\Deleted)] command adds the [\Deleted] flag to the message. It is not yet deleted;
  • lines 85-98: the [EXPUNGE] command deletes the messages that have the [\Deleted] flag. The [LOGOUT] command ends the dialogue;
  • lines 104-115: the [fetch] method sends a [FETCH] command and turns the list in the response [[* n FETCH (élément1 valeur1 élément2 valeur2...)]] into a dictionary [[élément1 => valeur1, élément2 => valeur2...]]. The [array_chunk] function splits the list into pairs, which the [foreach] loop destructures into [[$clé, $valeur]];
  • lines 120-133: the [commande] method sends a command preceded by its tag, then reads the server's responses up to the one that begins with the tag. If this final response is not [OK], an exception is thrown;
  • lines 146-153: reading a response. If a line ends with [{n}], n bytes follow (the literal), then the rest of the response. In the text of the response, each literal is replaced by a marker [\0k\0] (\0 is the character with code 0, which cannot appear in an IMAP text line) and its content is stored in the [$littéraux] array;
  • lines 163-209: the [jetons] method splits the text of a response into tokens:
    • a list in parentheses becomes an array. The method calls itself (recursive call) to parse the content of the list, and returns at the closing parenthesis;
    • a quoted string or a literal becomes a string;
    • [NIL] becomes [null];
    • everything else (an atom) becomes a string. An atom may contain brackets, which may themselves contain spaces and parentheses: [BODY[HEADER.FIELDS (FROM TO)]] is a single atom. The [match] expression adds 1 to the open-bracket counter for [[] and subtracts 1 from it for []];
    • the [$position] parameter, passed by reference, is the current position in the text: it advances as parsing proceeds, including in the recursive calls;
  • line 213: an IMAP string is enclosed in double quotes. The [addcslashes] function precedes the ["] and [\] characters with a [\] character.

docs.title: 16.6.5.5. The [PartieMime] class
docs.text:
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

// une partie d'un message MIME, telle que la décrit la réponse BODYSTRUCTURE d'un serveur IMAP
// un message est un arbre de parties : une partie [multipart/xxx] a des sous-parties
final readonly class PartieMime
{
    public function __construct(
        // type et sous-type MIME en minuscules : text/plain, multipart/mixed, application/pdf...
        public string $type,
        public string $sousType,
        // paramètres du type, par exemple [charset => utf-8]
        public array $paramètres = [],
        // codage du contenu : 7bit, 8bit, base64, quoted-printable...
        public string $codage = "7bit",
        // disposition (attachment, inline) ou null, et ses paramètres, par exemple [filename => x.pdf]
        public ?string $disposition = null,
        public array $paramètresDisposition = [],
        // les sous-parties d'une partie [multipart/xxx]
        public array $parties = [],
    ) {
    }

    // fabrique l'arbre des parties à partir de la liste de jetons BODYSTRUCTURE
    public static function depuisBodyStructure(array $structure): self
    {
        // partie multiple : ((sous-partie 1) (sous-partie 2)... "sous-type" (paramètres) disposition...)
        if (is_array($structure[0])) {
            // les sous-parties sont les premiers éléments qui sont des listes
            $parties = [];
            $i = 0;
            while (is_array($structure[$i])) {
                $parties[] = self::depuisBodyStructure($structure[$i++]);
            }
            return new self(
                type: "multipart",
                sousType: strtolower($structure[$i]),
                paramètres: self::dictionnaire($structure[$i + 1] ?? null),
                disposition: self::disposition($structure[$i + 2] ?? null)[0],
                paramètresDisposition: self::disposition($structure[$i + 2] ?? null)[1],
                parties: $parties,
            );
        }
        // partie simple : ("type" "sous-type" (paramètres) id description "codage" taille ...)
        $type = strtolower($structure[0]);
        $sousType = strtolower($structure[1]);
        // la disposition vient après des champs qui dépendent du type de la partie
        $indexDisposition = match (true) {
            // text/xxx : ... taille nbLignes md5 disposition
            $type === "text" => 9,
            // message/rfc822 : ... taille enveloppe structure nbLignes md5 disposition
            $type === "message" && $sousType === "rfc822" => 11,
            // autres : ... taille md5 disposition
            default => 8,
        };
        [$disposition, $paramètresDisposition] = self::disposition($structure[$indexDisposition] ?? null);
        return new self(
            type: $type,
            sousType: $sousType,
            paramètres: self::dictionnaire($structure[2]),
            codage: strtolower($structure[5] ?? "7bit"),
            disposition: $disposition,
            paramètresDisposition: $paramètresDisposition,
        );
    }

    // le nom du fichier d'une pièce jointe, ou null
    public function nomFichier(): ?string
    {
        // le nom est le paramètre [filename] de la disposition, ou à défaut le paramètre [name]
        // du type. Il peut être codé de deux façons :
        // - filename*=utf-8''Tah%C3%A9.png (RFC 2231) ;
        // - name="=?utf-8?Q?Tah=C3=A9.png?=" (RFC 2047) ;
        $codé = $this->paramètresDisposition["filename*"] ?? $this->paramètres["name*"] ?? null;
        if ($codé !== null) {
            // jeu de caractères''nom codé façon URL
            [$charset, , $nom] = explode("'", $codé, 3);
            return mb_convert_encoding(rawurldecode($nom), "UTF-8", $charset);
        }
        $nom = $this->paramètresDisposition["filename"] ?? $this->paramètres["name"] ?? null;
        return $nom === null ? null : iconv_mime_decode($nom, ICONV_MIME_DECODE_CONTINUE_ON_ERROR, "UTF-8");
    }

    // une liste IMAP (clé1 valeur1 clé2 valeur2...) ou NIL transformée en dictionnaire
    private static function dictionnaire(?array $liste): array
    {
        $dictionnaire = [];
        foreach (array_chunk($liste ?? [], 2) as [$clé, $valeur]) {
            $dictionnaire[strtolower($clé)] = $valeur;
        }
        return $dictionnaire;
    }

    // une disposition IMAP ("attachment" (paramètres)) ou NIL : rend [disposition, paramètres]
    private static function disposition(mixed $disposition): array
    {
        if (!is_array($disposition)) {
            return [null, []];
        }
        return [strtolower($disposition[0]), self::dictionnaire($disposition[1] ?? null)];
    }
}
  • line 7: a [readonly] class (PHP 8.2) has only read-only properties: once constructed, a [PartieMime] object can no longer be modified;
  • lines 9-22: all the properties are declared through constructor property promotion. They have default values, which makes it possible to pass only some parameters, by name (named arguments);
  • line 26: the static method [depuisBodyStructure] builds the tree of parts from the token list of the [BODYSTRUCTURE] response;
  • lines 29-42: a multipart part begins with the lists of its subparts, each turned into a [PartieMime] object by a recursive call. Then come its subtype (mixed, alternative...), its parameters (boundary) and its disposition;
  • lines 45-57: a simple part begins with its type, its subtype, its parameters, an identifier, a description, its encoding and its size. The position of the disposition depends on the type of the part: a [text/xxx] part additionally has a number of lines, a [message/rfc822] part additionally has the envelope and the structure of the message it contains, and a number of lines. The [match (true)] expression chooses the first arm whose condition is true;
  • lines 69-82: the file name of an attachment. We saw in [Mailpit] that it can be encoded in two ways:
    • the RFC 2231 encoding [utf-8''Tah%C3%A9.png]: the character set, two apostrophes, then the name encoded as in a URL. We decode it with [rawurldecode] and then convert it to UTF-8 with [mb_convert_encoding];
    • the RFC 2047 encoding [=?utf-8?Q?Tah=C3=A9.png?=]: we decode it with the [iconv_mime_decode] function;
  • line 86: an IMAP list [("charset" "utf-8")] becomes the dictionary [["charset" => "utf-8"]];
  • line 96: a disposition [("attachment" ("filename" "x.pdf"))] becomes the array [["attachment", ["filename" => "x.pdf"]]].

docs.title: 16.6.6. POP3 / IMAP client [imap-01.php]
docs.text:
The [imap-01.php] script plays the role of the script of the same name in the PHP 7 course, which used the [imap_open], [imap_num_msg], [imap_search], [imap_headerinfo], [imap_body], [imap_delete], [imap_expunge] and [imap_close] functions. It uses the following JSON file [config-imap-01.json]:

{
    "imap.gmail.com:993": {
        "enabled": false,
        "protocol": "imap",
        "server": "imap.gmail.com",
        "port": 993,
        "tls": true,
        "verify-peer": true,
        "user": "php8parlexemple@gmail.com",
        "password": "mot de passe d'application",
        "mailbox": "INBOX",
        "output-dir": "output/gmail-imap"
    },
    "localhost:993": {
        "protocol": "imap",
        "server": "localhost",
        "port": 993,
        "tls": true,
        "verify-peer": false,
        "user": "guest@localhost",
        "password": "guest",
        "mailbox": "INBOX",
        "output-dir": "output/localhost-imap"
    },
    "localhost:1110": {
        "protocol": "pop3",
        "server": "localhost",
        "port": 1110,
        "tls": false,
        "user": "guest",
        "password": "guest",
        "output-dir": "output/localhost-pop3"
    }
}

The [config-imap-01.json] file defines a dictionary of IMAP / POP3 servers to contact. Each element has the form [clé => valeur], where:

  • [clé]: is a name designating the server. We have three here:
    • [imap.gmail.com:993]: Gmail's IMAP server, which listens on port 993 with an encrypted connection. It is disabled ([enabled] set to [false]): put your Gmail address and your app password in it, then set [enabled] to [true];
    • [localhost:993]: the local IMAP server, with a connection encrypted by a self-signed certificate, which is not verified;
    • [localhost:1110]: [Mailpit]'s POP3 server;
  • [valeur]: is a dictionary specifying the following points:
    • [protocol]: the protocol, [imap] or [pop3];
    • [server]: the name of the IMAP or POP3 server;
    • [port]: the port of the IMAP or POP3 server;
    • [tls]: is the connection encrypted?
    • [verify-peer]: should the server's certificate be verified? On Windows, if verification fails with a public server, check that the [openssl.cafile] directive of the [php.ini] file points to a file of certificate authority certificates, as [Laragon] does;
    • [user]: the owner of the mailbox;
    • [password]: their password;
    • [mailbox]: the IMAP mailbox to read, INBOX being the one where new messages arrive;
    • [output-dir]: the folder in which the messages must be saved.

With the POP3 protocol, after reading a message, we will delete it. This is the usual way POP3 servers work: a message that has been read is not kept on the server.

The [imap-01.php] script is as follows:

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

// client IMAP (Internet Message Access Protocol) / POP3 permettant de lire des mails
// les boîtes à lettres à lire sont décrites dans un fichier de configuration

require_once __DIR__ . "/ImapClient.php";
require_once __DIR__ . "/Pop3Client.php";

// les paramètres de lecture du courrier
const CONFIG_FILE_NAME = "config-imap-01.json";
// affichage des échanges client / serveur ?
const SUIVI = false;

// on récupère la configuration
$mailboxes = json_decode(file_get_contents(CONFIG_FILE_NAME), true);

// lecture des boîtes à lettres
foreach ($mailboxes as $name => $infos) {
    // boîte à lettres désactivée dans la configuration ?
    if (($infos["enabled"] ?? true) === false) {
        print "------------Boîte à lettres [$name] désactivée\n";
        continue;
    }
    // suivi
    print "------------Lecture de la boîte à lettres [$name]\n";
    // lecture de la boîte à lettres
    readmailbox($name, $infos);
}
// fin
print "Terminé\n";

// --------------------------------------------------------------------------
function créerClient(array $infos): ClientMessagerie
{
    // un client IMAP ou POP3 selon la configuration
    return match ($infos["protocol"]) {
        "imap" => new ImapClient($infos, SUIVI),
        "pop3" => new Pop3Client($infos, SUIVI),
    };
}

// --------------------------------------------------------------------------
function readmailbox(string $name, array $infos): void
{
    // le client de la boîte à lettres
    $client = créerClient($infos);
    try {
        // connexion
        $nbmsg = $client->connecter();
        print "Connexion établie avec le serveur [$name].\n";
        // total des messages dans la boîte à lettres
        print "Il y a [$nbmsg] messages dans la boîte à lettres [$name]\n";
        if ($nbmsg === 0) {
            return;
        }
        // messages non lus dans la boîte à lettres
        print "Récupération de la liste des messages non lus de la boîte à lettres [$name]\n";
        $msgNumbers = $client->nonLus();
        if (count($msgNumbers) === 0) {
            print "Il n'y a pas de nouveaux messages dans la boîte à lettres [$name]\n";
            return;
        }
        foreach ($msgNumbers as $msgNumber) {
            // on récupère les entêtes du message n° $msgNumber
            print "Entêtes du message n° [$msgNumber] de la boîte à lettres [$name]\n";
            print_r($client->entêtes($msgNumber));
            // on récupère le texte complet du message n° $msgNumber et on l'enregistre
            saveMessage($client->message($msgNumber), $msgNumber, $infos);
            // si le protocole est POP3, on supprime le message
            if ($infos["protocol"] === "pop3") {
                $client->supprimer($msgNumber);
            }
        }
    } catch (RuntimeException $ex) {
        print "Erreur : " . $ex->getMessage() . "\n";
    } finally {
        // dans tous les cas, on ferme la connexion
        try {
            $client->fermer();
            print "Fermeture de la connexion réussie.\n";
        } catch (RuntimeException $ex) {
            print "La fermeture de la connexion a échoué : " . $ex->getMessage() . "\n";
        }
    }
}

// --------------------------------------------------------------------------
function saveMessage(string $message, int $msgNumber, array $infos): void
{
    // le message est enregistré dans le fichier [output-dir/message-N.eml]
    $fileName = "{$infos["output-dir"]}/message-$msgNumber.eml";
    print "Enregistrement du message dans le fichier [$fileName]\n";
    // on crée le dossier si besoin est (true : avec ses dossiers parents)
    if (!is_dir($infos["output-dir"])) {
        mkdir($infos["output-dir"], recursive: true);
    }
    // on enregistre le message
    if (file_put_contents($fileName, $message) === false) {
        print "Échec de l'enregistrement\n";
    }
}

Comments:

  • lines 8-9: we load the classes of the two clients, which themselves load the [ClientTcp] class and the [ClientMessagerie] interface;
  • line 14: when [true], the client / server exchanges are displayed. Try it;
  • lines 20-29: we loop over all the servers found in the configuration file, except those that are disabled;
  • lines 35-41: the [créerClient] function returns an IMAP or POP3 client depending on the configuration. Its return type is the [ClientMessagerie] interface: the rest of the script does not know which protocol it is dealing with. This is polymorphism;
  • line 51: connection and authentication;
  • line 60: the numbers of the unread messages;
  • line 68: we display the message headers with the [print_r] function;
  • line 70: we save the full text of the message in a file;
  • line 72: with the POP3 protocol, we mark the message so that it will be deleted;
  • lines 78-86: in all cases, we close the connection, which deletes the marked messages. If the [return] statements of the [try] block are executed, the [finally] block is executed too;
  • line 97: the [mkdir] function creates the folder, along with its parent folders thanks to the named argument [recursive: true].

Let's try to improve this script so as to get, in separate files, the various texts of the message as well as the attachments.

docs.title: 16.6.7. Improved IMAP client [imap-02.php]
docs.text:
The IMAP server can give us the structure of a message ([BODYSTRUCTURE] command) and then the content of each of its parts ([FETCH n BODY[section]] command). We are going to make use of this in the [imap-02.php] script. The POP3 protocol, for its part, only knows the whole message: the script will only handle IMAP mailboxes.

Let's go back to the response to the [BODYSTRUCTURE] command obtained while discovering the IMAP protocol. It describes a message of type [multipart/mixed] that has six parts:

  • the 1st part is of type [multipart/alternative]. It itself has two subparts: [text/plain] and [text/html], encoded in [quoted-printable] and having a [charset=utf-8] parameter;
  • the next five parts are the attachments, encoded in [base64], each having an [attachment] disposition with the file name.

The parts are numbered as follows:

  • the whole message, of type [multipart/mixed], has no number. Its parts are numbered 1, 2...;
  • when a part has subparts, these are numbered x.1, x.2..., where x is the number of the enclosing part. Thus, the [text/plain] text of the message is part no. 1.1: this is the one we requested with the [FETCH 2 BODY.PEEK[1.1]] command.

The [imap-02.php] script is as follows:

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

// client IMAP qui enregistre séparément les textes et les pièces jointes des messages non lus
// il utilise la structure MIME des messages fournie par le serveur IMAP (commande BODYSTRUCTURE)

require_once __DIR__ . "/ImapClient.php";

// les paramètres de lecture du courrier
const CONFIG_FILE_NAME = "config-imap-01.json";

// on récupère la configuration
$mailboxes = json_decode(file_get_contents(CONFIG_FILE_NAME), true);

// lecture des boîtes à lettres
foreach ($mailboxes as $name => $infos) {
    // seules les boîtes à lettres IMAP actives nous intéressent
    if (($infos["enabled"] ?? true) === false || $infos["protocol"] !== "imap") {
        continue;
    }
    print "------------Lecture de la boîte à lettres [$name]\n";
    readmailbox($name, $infos);
}
// fin
print "Terminé\n";

// --------------------------------------------------------------------------
function readmailbox(string $name, array $infos): void
{
    $client = new ImapClient($infos);
    try {
        // connexion
        $nbmsg = $client->connecter();
        print "Connexion établie avec le serveur [$name].\n";
        print "Il y a [$nbmsg] messages dans la boîte à lettres [$name]\n";
        // messages non lus
        print "Récupération de la liste des messages non lus de la boîte à lettres [$name]\n";
        $msgNumbers = $client->nonLus();
        if (count($msgNumbers) === 0) {
            print "Il n'y a pas de nouveaux messages dans la boîte à lettres [$name]\n";
        }
        foreach ($msgNumbers as $msgNumber) {
            // les entêtes du message serviront à préfixer ses textes
            $entêtes = $client->entêtes($msgNumber);
            // la structure du message
            $structure = $client->structure($msgNumber);
            // on parcourt ses parties
            $outputDir = "{$infos["output-dir"]}/message-$msgNumber";
            getParts($client, $msgNumber, $structure, "", $outputDir, $entêtes);
        }
    } catch (RuntimeException $ex) {
        print "Erreur : " . $ex->getMessage() . "\n";
    } finally {
        try {
            $client->fermer();
            print "Fermeture de la connexion réussie.\n";
        } catch (RuntimeException $ex) {
            print "La fermeture de la connexion a échoué : " . $ex->getMessage() . "\n";
        }
    }
}

// --------------------------------------------------------------------------
function getParts(ImapClient $client, int $msgNumber, PartieMime $part, string $section,
    string $outputDir, array $entêtes): void
{
    // affiche le type de la partie [$part] du message n° $msgNumber, puis :
    // - si elle a des sous-parties, les traite à leur tour (appel récursif) ;
    // - sinon, l'enregistre dans le dossier [$outputDir]
    // $section est le n° IMAP de la partie : 1, 2, 1.1, 1.2...
    // la partie racine (le message entier) n'a pas de n° : on affiche 0
    print "-----contenu de la partie n° [" . ($section === "" ? "0" : $section) . "]\n";
    print "Content-Type: " . strtoupper("$part->type/$part->sousType") . "\n";
    print "Transfer-Encoding : $part->codage\n";
    // des sous-parties ?
    if ($part->type === "multipart") {
        foreach ($part->parties as $i => $subpart) {
            // les sous-parties de la partie n° x sont numérotées x.1, x.2...
            $subsection = $section === "" ? (string) ($i + 1) : "$section." . ($i + 1);
            getParts($client, $msgNumber, $subpart, $subsection, $outputDir, $entêtes);
        }
        return;
    }
    // un message qui n'est pas multipart a une unique partie, de n° 1
    if ($section === "") {
        $section = "1";
    }
    // on enregistre la partie
    savePart($client, $msgNumber, $part, $section, $outputDir, $entêtes);
}

// --------------------------------------------------------------------------
function savePart(ImapClient $client, int $msgNumber, PartieMime $part, string $section,
    string $outputDir, array $entêtes): void
{
    // si le dossier n'existe pas, on le crée
    if (!is_dir($outputDir)) {
        mkdir($outputDir, recursive: true);
    }
    // une pièce jointe ?
    $nomFichier = $part->nomFichier();
    if ($part->disposition === "attachment" && $nomFichier !== null) {
        saveAttachment($client->partie($msgNumber, $section), $part, "$outputDir/$nomFichier");
        return;
    }
    // un texte ?
    match ("$part->type/$part->sousType") {
        "text/plain" => saveText("$outputDir/message.txt", false,
            $client->partie($msgNumber, $section), $part, $entêtes),
        "text/html" => saveText("$outputDir/message.html", true,
            $client->partie($msgNumber, $section), $part, $entêtes),
        // autres cas : on ne traitera pas cette partie
        default => print "Partie [$section] ignorée\n",
    };
}

// --------------------------------------------------------------------------
function décoder(string $texte, string $codage): string
{
    // décodage d'un contenu codé en base64 ou en quoted-printable
    return match ($codage) {
        "base64" => base64_decode($texte),
        "quoted-printable" => quoted_printable_decode($texte),
        // 7bit, 8bit, binary : pas de codage
        default => $texte,
    };
}

// --------------------------------------------------------------------------
function saveText(string $fileName, bool $html, string $texte, PartieMime $part, array $entêtes): void
{
    // le texte est décodé puis converti en UTF-8 s'il utilise un autre jeu de caractères
    $texte = décoder($texte, $part->codage);
    $charset = $part->paramètres["charset"] ?? "utf-8";
    if (strtolower($charset) !== "utf-8") {
        $texte = mb_convert_encoding($texte, "UTF-8", $charset);
    }
    // on le fait précéder des entêtes From, To, Subject du message
    $finDeLigne = $html ? "<br/>\n" : "\n";
    $contenu = "From: {$entêtes["From"]}$finDeLigne"
        . "To: {$entêtes["To"]}$finDeLigne"
        . "Subject: {$entêtes["Subject"]}$finDeLigne$finDeLigne"
        . $texte;
    print "Sauvegarde d'un message dans [$fileName]\n";
    if (file_put_contents($fileName, $contenu) === false) {
        print "Impossible de créer le fichier [$fileName]\n";
    }
}

// --------------------------------------------------------------------------
function saveAttachment(string $contenu, PartieMime $part, string $fileName): void
{
    print "Sauvegarde de la pièce jointe dans [$fileName]\n";
    if (file_put_contents($fileName, décoder($contenu, $part->codage)) === false) {
        print "La pièce jointe n'a pu être sauvegardée dans [$fileName]\n";
    }
}

Comments:

  • line 19: only active IMAP mailboxes are read;
  • line 45: the message headers will be used to prefix the saved texts;
  • line 47: the structure of the message: a [PartieMime] object;
  • line 50: the [getParts] function walks through the parts of the message. We start with the root part, the whole message, which has no section number;
  • line 65: the [getParts] function receives the following parameters:
    • [$client]: the IMAP client;
    • [$msgNumber]: the number of the message whose parts we want;
    • [$part]: an object representing a part of the message;
    • [$section]: the number of this part;
    • [$outputDir]: the folder in which to save the parts;
    • [$entêtes]: general information about the email (sender, recipient, subject...);
  • lines 73-75: we display the part number, its content type and its encoding. The whole message is displayed as part no. 0;
  • lines 77-83: if the part has subparts, we ask to see each of them through a recursive call to the [getParts] function. Their section number is [$section.i];
  • lines 86-87: a message that is not multipart (a plain text) has only one part, numbered 1;
  • line 90: when there are no subparts, we save the content of the part;
  • line 94: the [savePart] function saves a part:
    • if it is an attachment ([attachment] disposition), it is saved with the [saveAttachment] function under its file name;
    • if it is a [text/plain] or [text/html] text, it is saved with the [saveText] function in the [message.txt] or [message.html] file. The other parts are ignored;
    • in both cases, the content of the part is requested from the IMAP server by the client's [partie] method;
  • line 119: the content of a part is encoded. The [base64_decode] and [quoted_printable_decode] functions decode it;
  • line 131: the text is decoded, then converted to UTF-8 with the [mb_convert_encoding] function if it uses another character set ([charset] parameter). It is preceded by the [From], [To] and [Subject] headers of the message. In the case of an HTML text, each header is followed by a [<br/>] tag so that it is on its own line in a browser;
  • line 152: an attachment is decoded and then saved.

To test the [imap-02.php] script, we first send an email to [guest@localhost] with the [smtp-02.php] script (the [test-localhost] message and its five attachments), which we place in the INBOX mailbox of the IMAP server. We then read it with [imap-02.php]. The console results are as follows:

> php imap-02.php

Il y a [3] messages dans la boîte à lettres [localhost:993]
Récupération de la liste des messages non lus de la boîte à lettres [localhost:993]
-----contenu de la partie n° [0]
Content-Type: MULTIPART/MIXED
Transfer-Encoding : 7bit
-----contenu de la partie n° [1]

Transfer-Encoding : 7bit
-----contenu de la partie n° [1.1]
Content-Type: TEXT/PLAIN
Transfer-Encoding : quoted-printable
Sauvegarde d'un message dans [output/localhost-imap/message-3/message.txt]
-----contenu de la partie n° [1.2]
Content-Type: TEXT/HTML
Transfer-Encoding : quoted-printable
Sauvegarde d'un message dans [output/localhost-imap/message-3/message.html]
-----contenu de la partie n° [2]
Content-Type: APPLICATION/VND.OPENXMLFORMATS-OFFICEDOCUMENT.WORDPROCESSINGML.DOCUMENT
Transfer-Encoding : base64
Sauvegarde de la pièce jointe dans [output/localhost-imap/message-3/Hello from Symfony Mailer.docx]
-----contenu de la partie n° [3]
Content-Type: APPLICATION/PDF
Transfer-Encoding : base64
Sauvegarde de la pièce jointe dans [output/localhost-imap/message-3/Hello from Symfony Mailer.pdf]
-----contenu de la partie n° [4]
Content-Type: APPLICATION/VND.OASIS.OPENDOCUMENT.TEXT
Transfer-Encoding : base64
Sauvegarde de la pièce jointe dans [output/localhost-imap/message-3/Hello from Symfony Mailer.odt]
-----contenu de la partie n° [5]
Content-Type: IMAGE/PNG
Transfer-Encoding : base64
Sauvegarde de la pièce jointe dans [output/localhost-imap/message-3/Cours-Tutoriels-Serge-Tahé-1568x268.png]
-----contenu de la partie n° [6]
Content-Type: MESSAGE/RFC822
Transfer-Encoding : base64
Sauvegarde de la pièce jointe dans [output/localhost-imap/message-3/test-localhost.eml]
Fermeture de la connexion réussie.
Terminé

We do find the structure of the message. The files have been saved in the [output/localhost-imap/message-3] folder:

message-3
├── Cours-Tutoriels-Serge-Tahé-1568x268.png
├── Hello from Symfony Mailer.docx
├── Hello from Symfony Mailer.odt
├── Hello from Symfony Mailer.pdf
├── message.html
├── message.txt
└── test-localhost.eml

The Word, PDF and OpenOffice documents and the image open normally: they have been decoded correctly.

The attached message [test-localhost.eml] has been saved as an attachment. Yet it is itself an email which, in turn, has texts and attachments. Note in the [BODYSTRUCTURE] response that the server was unable to analyze this attached message, because it is encoded in base64: it gives an empty envelope [(NIL NIL ...)] for it and a structure reduced to an empty text. To go further, we would have to download the attached message, decode it and analyze its MIME structure ourselves. And this message could itself contain an attached email, and so on. Rather than writing this parser, we are going to use a library.

docs.title: 16.6.8. POP3 / IMAP client with the [zbateson/mail-mime-parser] library
docs.text:
The PHP 7 course used the [php-mime-mail-parser] library, which required the PHP extension [mailparse], to be downloaded and installed separately. We will use the [zbateson/mail-mime-parser] library (https://github.com/zbateson/mail-mime-parser), written entirely in PHP: it was installed by the [composer install] command along with the course's other dependencies, with nothing else to do. It parses the full text of a message, as returned by the POP3 [RETR] and IMAP [FETCH n BODY[]] commands. The [imap-03.php] script will therefore work with both protocols.

To test it, we will send a message whose last attachment [test-localhost-2.eml] itself contains an attached email [test-localhost.eml]:

  • [test-localhost-2.eml] contains 4 attachments (the Word, PDF and OpenOffice documents and the image) and the email [test-localhost.eml];
  • [test-localhost.eml] contains the same 4 attachments.

The [config-smtp-03.json] configuration file describes this send:

{
    "mail to localhost via localhost": {
        "smtp-server": "localhost",
        "smtp-port": 1025,
        "from": "guest@localhost",
        "to": "guest@localhost",
        "subject": "test-localhost-3",
        "message": "ligne 1\nligne 2\nligne 3",
        "tls": false,
        "attachments": [
            "/attachments/Hello from Symfony Mailer.docx",
            "/attachments/Hello from Symfony Mailer.pdf",
            "/attachments/Hello from Symfony Mailer.odt",
            "/attachments/Cours-Tutoriels-Serge-Tahé-1568x268.png",
            "/attachments/test-localhost-2.eml"
        ]
    }
}

It is used with the command [php smtp-02.php config-smtp-03.json].

The [imap-03.php] script uses the same configuration file [config-imap-01.json] as the previous scripts. It is as follows:

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

// client IMAP / POP3 permettant de lire des mails
// l'analyse des messages est confiée à la bibliothèque [zbateson/mail-mime-parser]
// disponible à l'URL [https://github.com/zbateson/mail-mime-parser]

// dépendances
require_once __DIR__ . "/../../../vendor/autoload.php";
require_once __DIR__ . "/ImapClient.php";
require_once __DIR__ . "/Pop3Client.php";

use ZBateson\MailMimeParser\IMessage;
use ZBateson\MailMimeParser\Message;

// les paramètres de lecture du courrier
const CONFIG_FILE_NAME = "config-imap-01.json";

// on récupère la configuration
if (!file_exists(CONFIG_FILE_NAME)) {
    print "Le fichier de configuration " . CONFIG_FILE_NAME . " n'existe pas\n";
    exit(1);
}
$mailboxes = json_decode(file_get_contents(CONFIG_FILE_NAME), true);

// lecture des boîtes à lettres
foreach ($mailboxes as $name => $infos) {
    if (($infos["enabled"] ?? true) === false) {
        continue;
    }
    print "------------Lecture de la boîte à lettres [$name]\n";
    readmailbox($name, $infos);
}
// fin
print "Terminé\n";

// --------------------------------------------------------------------------
function readmailbox(string $name, array $infos): void
{
    // un client IMAP ou POP3 selon la configuration
    $client = match ($infos["protocol"]) {
        "imap" => new ImapClient($infos),
        "pop3" => new Pop3Client($infos),
    };
    try {
        // connexion
        $nbmsg = $client->connecter();
        print "Connexion établie avec le serveur [$name].\n";
        print "Il y a [$nbmsg] messages dans la boîte à lettres [$name]\n";
        // messages non lus
        print "Récupération de la liste des messages non lus de la boîte à lettres [$name]\n";
        $msgNumbers = $client->nonLus();
        if (count($msgNumbers) === 0) {
            print "Il n'y a pas de nouveaux messages dans la boîte à lettres [$name]\n";
        }
        // on parcourt la liste des messages non lus
        foreach ($msgNumbers as $msgNumber) {
            print "---message n° [$msgNumber]\n";
            // on récupère le texte complet du message et on l'analyse
            getMailBody($client->message($msgNumber), "{$infos["output-dir"]}/message-$msgNumber");
            // si le protocole est POP3, on supprime le message après l'avoir récupéré
            if ($infos["protocol"] === "pop3") {
                $client->supprimer($msgNumber);
            }
        }
    } catch (RuntimeException $ex) {
        print "Erreur : " . $ex->getMessage() . "\n";
    } finally {
        try {
            $client->fermer();
            print "Fermeture de la connexion réussie.\n";
        } catch (RuntimeException $ex) {
            print "La fermeture de la connexion a échoué : " . $ex->getMessage() . "\n";
        }
    }
}

// --------------------------------------------------------------------------
// analyse du texte complet d'un message
function getMailBody(string $text, string $outputDir): void
{
    // la bibliothèque analyse le texte du message et en fait un objet [IMessage]
    // (false : le texte n'est plus utilisé une fois l'objet construit)
    $message = Message::from($text, false);
    // on sauvegarde les différentes parties du message dans le dossier [$outputDir]
    getParts($message, $outputDir);
}

// --------------------------------------------------------------------------
// sauvegarde des différentes parties d'un message
function getParts(IMessage $message, string $outputDir): void
{
    // on crée le dossier de sauvegarde du message si besoin est
    if (!is_dir($outputDir) && !mkdir($outputDir, recursive: true)) {
        print "Le dossier [$outputDir] n'a pu être créé\n";
        return;
    }
    // les entêtes du message (from, to, subject...), décodés
    $entêtes = [];
    foreach ($message->getAllHeaders() as $header) {
        $entêtes[] = "{$header->getName()}: {$header->getValue()}";
    }
    // on sauvegarde les messages texte
    for ($i = 1; $i <= $message->getTextPartCount(); $i++) {
        print "-- Sauvegarde d'un message de type [text/plain]\n";
        saveMessage($message->getTextContent($i - 1), false, $entêtes, "$outputDir/message_$i.txt");
    }
    // on sauvegarde les messages html
    for ($i = 1; $i <= $message->getHtmlPartCount(); $i++) {
        print "-- Sauvegarde d'un message de type [text/html]\n";
        saveMessage($message->getHtmlContent($i - 1), true, $entêtes, "$outputDir/message_$i.html");
    }
    // on parcourt la liste des pièces jointes
    $iAttachment = 0;
    foreach ($message->getAllAttachmentParts() as $attachment) {
        // type et nom de la pièce jointe
        $fileType = $attachment->getContentType();
        $fileName = nomLibre($outputDir, $attachment->getFilename() ?? "piece-jointe");
        print "-- Sauvegarde d'une pièce jointe de type [$fileType] dans le fichier [$fileName]\n";
        // on sauvegarde la pièce jointe, décodée
        $attachment->saveContent($fileName);
        // cas particulier du type message/rfc822
        if ($fileType === "message/rfc822") {
            // la pièce jointe est elle-même un message - on l'analyse de façon récursive
            // dans un sous-dossier [rfc822-1], [rfc822-2]...
            $iAttachment++;
            $attachedMessage = Message::from($attachment->getBinaryContentStream()->getContents(), false);
            getParts($attachedMessage, "$outputDir/rfc822-$iAttachment");
        }
    }
}

// --------------------------------------------------------------------------
// un nom de fichier libre dans le dossier [$dir] : x.pdf, sinon x_1.pdf, x_2.pdf...
function nomLibre(string $dir, string $nom): string
{
    $info = pathinfo($nom);
    $extension = isset($info["extension"]) ? ".{$info["extension"]}" : "";
    $candidat = "$dir/$nom";
    for ($i = 1; file_exists($candidat); $i++) {
        $candidat = "$dir/{$info["filename"]}_$i$extension";
    }
    return $candidat;
}

// --------------------------------------------------------------------------
// sauvegarde d'un message texte précédé des entêtes du message
function saveMessage(string $text, bool $html, array $entêtes, string $filename): void
{
    // en HTML, chaque entête est terminé par <br/> pour être seul sur sa ligne
    $finDeLigne = $html ? "<br/>\n" : "\n";
    $contents = implode($finDeLigne, $entêtes) . $finDeLigne . $finDeLigne . $text;
    if (file_put_contents($filename, $contents) === false) {
        print "Le message n'a pu être sauvegardé dans le fichier [$filename]\n";
    } else {
        print "Le message a été sauvegardé dans le fichier [$filename]\n";
    }
}

Comments:

  • line 10: Composer's class loader, for the [zbateson/mail-mime-parser] library;
  • lines 14-15: the two types of the library that we use: the [IMessage] interface and the [Message] class that implements it;
  • line 21: we check that the configuration file exists;
  • line 39: the [readmailbox] function has the same structure as in [imap-01.php]. This time, the IMAP or POP3 client is created directly by a [match] expression;
  • line 61: we pass the full text of the message to the [getMailBody] function;
  • lines 81-87: the static method [Message::from] parses the text of the message and returns an [IMessage] object. The [getParts] function then saves its various parts;
  • line 92: the [getParts] function takes two parameters:
    • the message [$message] to analyze;
    • [$outputDir]: the folder in which the texts and attachments of the message must be saved;
  • lines 101-102: we retrieve the headers of the message being analyzed (from, to, subject...). The [getValue] method returns the decoded value of a header;
  • lines 105-107: a message may have several [text/plain] parts. The method [getTextContent($i - 1)] returns the text of the i-th one (the parts are numbered from 0), decoded and converted to UTF-8. We save them all, giving each one a different file name;
  • lines 110-112: likewise for the [text/html] parts;
  • line 116: we go through the list of the message's attachments;
  • lines 118-119: the type of the attachment (Content-Type header) and its name, decoded by the library, however it is encoded. The [nomLibre] function returns a file name that does not yet exist in the folder;
  • line 122: the [saveContent] method saves the decoded content of the attachment to a file;
  • lines 124-129: if the attachment is an email, it is analyzed in turn, through a recursive call to the [getParts] function. Its decoded content is obtained with the [getBinaryContentStream] method, which returns a stream whose entire content is read with the [getContents] method. If the analyzed message has two attached emails, the 1st will be saved in the [$outputDir/rfc822-1] folder and the second in the [$outputDir/rfc822-2] folder;
  • line 136: if the file [x.pdf] already exists, the [nomLibre] function tries the names [x_1.pdf], [x_2.pdf]... until it finds a file name that does not exist. The [pathinfo] function splits a file name into a name (filename) and an extension (extension);
  • line 149: the [saveMessage] function saves a text of the message preceded by the message headers. In the case of an HTML text, each header is terminated by the [<br/>] tag.

The scripts of this chapter are in two folders of the [scripts-console] folder of the course code:

    │   ├── phpinfo.php
