docs.title: 14. Practical exercise – version 6
docs.text:
We have just implemented the following layered structure:

The DBMS used in the examples was MySQL. In the previous chapter, we noted that nothing in the classes implementing the [dao] layer suggested that a particular DBMS was being used. This is what we are now going to verify by using another DBMS, PostgreSQL. The layered architecture becomes the following:

Version 6 contains no new class: it uses the classes of version 5. It contains only data files and new main scripts:

version-06
├── Data
│   ├── database.json
│   ├── errors.json
│   ├── postgres-dbimpots-2019.sql
│   ├── resultats.json
│   ├── taxadmindata.json
│   └── taxpayersdata.json
├── Main
│   ├── MainCalculateImpotsWithTaxAdminDataInPostgresDatabase.php
│   └── MainTransferAdminDataFromJsonFile2PostgresDatabase.php
└── Tests
    ├── data
    │   ├── database-incomplet.json
    │   └── database-mdp-errone.json
    ├── DaoTest.php
    └── MetierTest.php

docs.title: 14.1. Installing the PostgreSQL DBMS
docs.text:
The PHP 7 course downloaded the PostgreSQL installer for Windows from the site [https://www.postgresql.org/download/], ran it, then changed the PostgreSQL Windows service, which started automatically when the machine booted, into a manually started service. With [Laragon], none of this is necessary: PostgreSQL is one of the services managed by [Laragon], just like Apache and MySQL. It is started and stopped from the [Laragon] menu (PostgreSQL menu), and it runs only when we need it. Like MySQL, it listens on the local machine, on port 5432, its default port.

Like MySQL, PostgreSQL has an administrator, the superuser [postgres]. In the [Laragon] installation, it has no password. If it has been given a password, the tools will ask for it.

The [Laragon] terminal gives access to PostgreSQL's command-line client, [psql], the equivalent of the [mysql] client. The PostgreSQL documentation is available at [https://www.postgresql.org/docs/].

docs.title: 14.2. Enabling the PostgreSQL PDO extension
docs.text:
The PostgreSQL PDO driver is PHP's [pdo_pgsql] extension. We enable it as we did for the MySQL driver:

  • either from the [Laragon] menu: PHP / Extensions / pdo_pgsql;
  • or by checking that the following line is not commented out (no semicolon at the start of the line) in the [php.ini] file ([Laragon] menu PHP / php.ini):
extension=pdo_pgsql

After saving the change, we restart the [Laragon] services ([Reload] button). We then check that the driver is present with the [pdo-drivers.php] script from the chapter on MySQL, run in the [scripts-console/mysql] folder:

> php pdo-drivers.php
Pilotes PDO disponibles : mysql, pgsql, sqlite
extension [pdo_mysql] : chargée
extension [pdo_pgsql] : chargée
extension [pdo_sqlite] : chargée

The [pgsql] driver is among the available drivers.

docs.title: 14.3. Creating the [dbimpots-2019] database
docs.text:
With PostgreSQL, we are going to create:

  • a user [admimpots] with the password [mdpimpots];
  • a database [dbimpots-2019] of which this user will be the owner;
  • in this database, the tables [tbtranches] and [tbconstantes].

The PHP 7 course did this work with the administration tool [pgAdmin], a web application to be installed in addition to the DBMS. As for MySQL, we instead write an SQL script [Data/postgres-dbimpots-2019.sql]:

-- base de données [dbimpots-2019] de l'application de calcul de l'impôt - SGBD PostgreSQL
-- à exécuter par l'administrateur [postgres] du SGBD :
--   psql -U postgres -f postgres-dbimpots-2019.sql
-- la base, ses tables et son propriétaire sont recréés s'ils existent déjà

-- la base de données et son propriétaire [admimpots] de mot de passe [mdpimpots]
DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS "dbimpots-2019";
DROP ROLE IF EXISTS admimpots;
CREATE ROLE admimpots LOGIN PASSWORD 'mdpimpots';
CREATE DATABASE "dbimpots-2019" OWNER admimpots ENCODING 'UTF8' TEMPLATE template0;

-- connexion à la nouvelle base (commande du client psql)
\connect dbimpots-2019

-- les tables sont créées par [admimpots] : il en sera le propriétaire
SET ROLE admimpots;

-- la table des tranches d'impôt
CREATE TABLE tbtranches (
    id INTEGER GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY,
    limites NUMERIC(10, 2) NOT NULL,
    coeffr NUMERIC(6, 2) NOT NULL,
    coeffn NUMERIC(10, 2) NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (id)
);

-- la table des constantes de calcul de l'impôt
CREATE TABLE tbconstantes (
    id INTEGER GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY,
    plafond_qf_demi_part NUMERIC(10, 2) NOT NULL,
    plafond_revenus_celibataire_pour_reduction NUMERIC(10, 2) NOT NULL,
    plafond_revenus_couple_pour_reduction NUMERIC(10, 2) NOT NULL,
    valeur_reduc_demi_part NUMERIC(10, 2) NOT NULL,
    plafond_decote_celibataire NUMERIC(10, 2) NOT NULL,
    plafond_decote_couple NUMERIC(10, 2) NOT NULL,
    plafond_impot_celibataire_pour_decote NUMERIC(10, 2) NOT NULL,
    plafond_impot_couple_pour_decote NUMERIC(10, 2) NOT NULL,
    abattement_dix_pourcent_max NUMERIC(10, 2) NOT NULL,
    abattement_dix_pourcent_min NUMERIC(10, 2) NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (id)
);

Comments

  • lines 7-8: we delete the database and the user if they exist, so that the script can be rerun. With PostgreSQL, a name containing a hyphen is surrounded by double quotes, and not by backquotes as with MySQL: this is a first difference between the two DBMSs;
  • line 9: PostgreSQL calls its users "roles". The [LOGIN] attribute allows the role [admimpots] to connect to the DBMS;
  • line 10: creation of the [dbimpots-2019] database. Its owner is [admimpots], which gives it all privileges on the database. The character encoding is UTF-8. The database is built from the template database [template0], which accepts any encoding;
  • line 13: this line is not an SQL statement but a command of the [psql] client (it begins with a backslash). It connects the client to the [dbimpots-2019] database that has just been created. With PostgreSQL, there is no equivalent of MySQL's [USE] statement: a connection works on a single database;
  • line 16: the following statements are executed as [admimpots], who will thus be the owner of the tables created;
  • lines 19-25: the [tbtranches] table. The primary key [id] is of type [INTEGER GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY]: the DBMS generates its values at insertion time, as MySQL's [AUTO_INCREMENT] attribute did. This syntax is that of the SQL standard; [AUTO_INCREMENT] is MySQL-specific. The [NUMERIC] type is the equivalent of MySQL's [DECIMAL] type;
  • lines 28-41: the [tbconstantes] table. The column names are written in lowercase, with words separated by underscores (plafond_qf_demi_part).

Why these column names? A peculiarity of PostgreSQL is that column names can be case-sensitive (uppercase / lowercase), which is not usually the case with other DBMSs. Thus with MySQL, the statement [select limites, coeffR, coeffN from tbtranches] works even if the actual columns of the [tbtranches] table are [LIMITES, COEFFR, COEFFN]. With PostgreSQL, it does not work, because PostgreSQL converts names that are not surrounded by double quotes to lowercase: it actually executes the statement [select limites, coeffr, coeffn from tbtranches]. To prevent it from doing so, you must write [select "LIMITES", "COEFFR", "COEFFN" from tbtranches], that is, protect the column names with double quotes. For these reasons, we give the columns lowercase names, and we cannot reuse the camelCase names (plafondQfDemiPart) of the MySQL database. The names of database objects can be a source of incompatibility between DBMSs, some names being reserved words in some DBMSs and not in others.

This script must be run by the superuser [postgres]. In the [Laragon] terminal opened in the [version-06/Data] folder, we type the following command (the [-U] option gives the user name, the [-f] option the file to execute):

> psql -U postgres -f postgres-dbimpots-2019.sql
psql:postgres-dbimpots-2019.sql:7: NOTICE:  database "dbimpots-2019" does not exist, skipping
DROP DATABASE
psql:postgres-dbimpots-2019.sql:8: NOTICE:  role "admimpots" does not exist, skipping
DROP ROLE
CREATE ROLE
CREATE DATABASE
You are now connected to database "dbimpots-2019" as user "postgres".
SET
CREATE TABLE
CREATE TABLE
  • lines 2 and 4: the warnings (NOTICE) of the [DROP ... IF EXISTS] statements on the first run: the database and the role did not exist;
  • the other lines are the reports of the statements executed.

We check the result by connecting to the database as [admimpots]. The [-h localhost] option forces a network connection to the local machine, with a password, as PHP will do. [psql] then asks for the password of [admimpots]. The [-c] option passes a command to execute; the [psql] command [\dt] lists the tables of the database:

> psql -U admimpots -h localhost -d dbimpots-2019 -c "\dt"
             List of relations
 Schema |     Name     | Type  |   Owner
--------+--------------+-------+-----------
 public | tbconstantes | table | admimpots
 public | tbtranches   | table | admimpots
(2 rows)

and the command [\d tbtranches] displays the structure of the [tbtranches] table:

> psql -U admimpots -h localhost -d dbimpots-2019 -c "\d tbtranches"
                           Table "public.tbtranches"
 Column  |     Type      | Collation | Nullable |           Default
---------+---------------+-----------+----------+------------------------------
 id      | integer       |           | not null | generated always as identity
 limites | numeric(10,2) |           | not null |
 coeffr  | numeric(6,2)  |           | not null |
 coeffn  | numeric(10,2) |           | not null |
Indexes:
    "tbtranches_pkey" PRIMARY KEY, btree (id)
  • line 5: the primary key [id], generated by the DBMS (generated always as identity);
  • lines 9-10: the primary key index.

PostgreSQL can also be administered graphically. The [HeidiSQL] tool shipped with [Laragon] can connect to a PostgreSQL server (network type "PostgreSQL (TCP/IP)", port 5432). The [pgAdmin] tool from the PHP 7 course can also be used ([https://www.pgadmin.org/]).

docs.title: 14.4. Populating the [dbimpots-2019] database
docs.text:
We have already done this work with the MySQL DBMS in version 5. All we need to do is modify the [database.json] file that describes the database. The [version-06/Data/database.json] file is the following:

{
    "dsn": "pgsql:host=localhost;dbname=dbimpots-2019",
    "id": "admimpots",
    "pwd": "mdpimpots",
    "tableTranches": "public.tbtranches",
    "colId": "id",
    "colLimites": "limites",
    "colCoeffR": "coeffr",
    "colCoeffN": "coeffn",
    "tableConstantes": "public.tbconstantes",
    "colPlafondQfDemiPart": "plafond_qf_demi_part",
    "colPlafondRevenusCelibatairePourReduction": "plafond_revenus_celibataire_pour_reduction",
    "colPlafondRevenusCouplePourReduction": "plafond_revenus_couple_pour_reduction",
    "colValeurReducDemiPart": "valeur_reduc_demi_part",
    "colPlafondDecoteCelibataire": "plafond_decote_celibataire",
    "colPlafondDecoteCouple": "plafond_decote_couple",
    "colPlafondImpotCelibatairePourDecote": "plafond_impot_celibataire_pour_decote",
    "colPlafondImpotCouplePourDecote": "plafond_impot_couple_pour_decote",
    "colAbattementDixPourcentMax": "abattement_dix_pourcent_max",
    "colAbattementDixPourcentMin": "abattement_dix_pourcent_min"
}
  • line 2: the DSN has changed: the [pgsql] prefix indicates that we are dealing with the PostgreSQL DBMS. The port is not specified: it is PostgreSQL's default port, 5432;
  • line 5 and line 10: we have prefixed the table names with the name of the schema they belong to, [public]. A PostgreSQL database can contain several schemas, which are namespaces for tables. This was not essential, since [public] is the schema used by default when no schema is specified in the table name;
  • lines 11-20: the column names of the constants table have changed.

The script [Main/MainTransferAdminDataFromJsonFile2PostgresDatabase.php] that populates the [dbimpots-2019] database is the following:

<?php

// respect strict des types déclarés des paramètres et des résultats des fonctions
declare(strict_types=1);

// espace de noms
namespace Application;

// inclusion des interfaces et classes de la version 5 nécessaires au transfert
require_once __DIR__ . "/../../version-05/Entities/ExceptionImpots.php";
require_once __DIR__ . "/../../version-05/Entities/TaxAdminData.php";
require_once __DIR__ . "/../../version-05/Entities/Database.php";
require_once __DIR__ . "/../../version-05/Utilities/Utilitaires.php";
require_once __DIR__ . "/../../version-05/Dao/InterfaceDao4TransferAdminData2Database.php";
require_once __DIR__ . "/../../version-05/Dao/DaoTransferAdminDataFromJsonFile2Database.php";

// définition des constantes
const DATABASE_CONFIG_FILENAME = __DIR__ . "/../Data/database.json";
const TAXADMINDATA_FILENAME = __DIR__ . "/../Data/taxadmindata.json";

try {
    // création de la couche [dao]
    $dao = new DaoTransferAdminDataFromJsonFile2Database(DATABASE_CONFIG_FILENAME, TAXADMINDATA_FILENAME);
    // transfert des données dans la base
    $dao->transferAdminData2Database();
    print "Les données de l'administration fiscale ont été transférées dans la base de données\n";
} catch (ExceptionImpots $ex) {
    // on affiche l'erreur
    print "Erreur n° {$ex->getCode()} : {$ex->getMessage()}\n";
}
// fin
print "Terminé\n";

Comments

Only lines 10-15, which load the files needed to run the application, change compared with the version 5 script: the files are now taken from the [version-05] folder, next to the [version-06] folder. The constants lines 18-19, for their part, designate the files of the [version-06/Data] folder.

When we run this script, we get the following result:

> php MainTransferAdminDataFromJsonFile2PostgresDatabase.php
Les données de l'administration fiscale ont été transférées dans la base de données
Terminé

and the following contents in the [tbtranches] table:

> psql -U admimpots -h localhost -d dbimpots-2019 -c "select * from tbtranches"
 id |  limites  | coeffr |  coeffn
----+-----------+--------+----------
  1 |   9964.00 |   0.00 |     0.00
  2 |  27519.00 |   0.14 |  1394.96
  3 |  73779.00 |   0.30 |  5798.00
  4 | 156244.00 |   0.41 | 13913.69
  5 |      0.00 |   0.45 | 20163.45
(5 rows)

We do the same for the constants table [tbconstantes]. The [-x] option of [psql] displays each row vertically:

> psql -U admimpots -h localhost -d dbimpots-2019 -x -c "select * from tbconstantes"
-[ RECORD 1 ]------------------------------+---------
id                                         | 1
plafond_qf_demi_part                       | 1551.00
plafond_revenus_celibataire_pour_reduction | 21037.00
plafond_revenus_couple_pour_reduction      | 42074.00
valeur_reduc_demi_part                     | 3797.00
plafond_decote_celibataire                 | 1196.00
plafond_decote_couple                      | 1970.00
plafond_impot_celibataire_pour_decote      | 1595.00

This time the [PDO::connect] method created an object of the [Pdo\Pgsql] class, and the PostgreSQL driver was used, without a single line of the [DaoTransferAdminDataFromJsonFile2Database] class having been modified. Note that to run the script, we need neither the Apache server nor the MySQL DBMS: only the PostgreSQL DBMS must be running.

docs.title: 14.5. Tax calculation
docs.text:
The [dao] [3] and [métier] [2] layers have already been written. We already wrote the main script for the MySQL DBMS in version 5. All we need to do is take the [MainCalculateImpotsWithTaxAdminDataInMySQLDatabase.php] script and adapt it to the PostgreSQL DBMS. It is now called [MainCalculateImpotsWithTaxAdminDataInPostgresDatabase.php]:

<?php

// respect strict des types déclarés des paramètres et des résultats des fonctions
declare(strict_types=1);

// espace de noms
namespace Application;

// inclusion des interfaces et classes de la version 5
require_once __DIR__ . "/../../version-05/Entities/ExceptionImpots.php";
require_once __DIR__ . "/../../version-05/Entities/TaxAdminData.php";
require_once __DIR__ . "/../../version-05/Entities/TaxPayerData.php";
require_once __DIR__ . "/../../version-05/Entities/Database.php";
require_once __DIR__ . "/../../version-05/Utilities/Utilitaires.php";
require_once __DIR__ . "/../../version-05/Dao/InterfaceDao.php";
require_once __DIR__ . "/../../version-05/Dao/TraitDao.php";
require_once __DIR__ . "/../../version-05/Dao/DaoImpotsWithTaxAdminDataInDatabase.php";
require_once __DIR__ . "/../../version-05/Metier/InterfaceMetier.php";
require_once __DIR__ . "/../../version-05/Metier/Metier.php";

// définition des constantes
const DATABASE_CONFIG_FILENAME = __DIR__ . "/../Data/database.json";
const TAXPAYERSDATA_FILENAME = __DIR__ . "/../Data/taxpayersdata.json";
const RESULTS_FILENAME = __DIR__ . "/../Data/resultats.json";
const ERRORS_FILENAME = __DIR__ . "/../Data/errors.json";

try {
    // création de la couche [dao]
    $dao = new DaoImpotsWithTaxAdminDataInDatabase(DATABASE_CONFIG_FILENAME);
    // création de la couche [métier]
    $métier = new Metier($dao);
    // calcul de l'impôt en mode batch
    $métier->executeBatchImpots(TAXPAYERSDATA_FILENAME, RESULTS_FILENAME, ERRORS_FILENAME);
    print "Les résultats ont été enregistrés dans le fichier [resultats.json]\n";
} catch (ExceptionImpots $ex) {
    // on affiche l'erreur
    print "Erreur n° {$ex->getCode()} : {$ex->getMessage()}\n";
}
// fin
print "Terminé\n";

Comments

Here again, only lines 10-19, which load the version 5 files, change. The JSON files used are those of the [version-06/Data] folder, in particular the [database.json] file that describes the PostgreSQL database.

Execution results

> php MainCalculateImpotsWithTaxAdminDataInPostgresDatabase.php
Les résultats ont été enregistrés dans le fichier [resultats.json]
Terminé

The [errors.json] and [resultats.json] files produced in the [version-06/Data] folder are identical to those obtained with the MySQL database in version 5.

docs.title: 14.6. [PHPUnit] tests
docs.text: As for the previous versions, we validate this version with [PHPUnit] tests. The test classes [DaoTest] and [MetierTest] in the [version-06/Tests] folder are those of version 5. Only the test environment changes: the application's files are loaded from the [version-05] folder and the data is that of the [version-06/Data] folder.

docs.title: 14.6.1. Testing the [dao] layer
docs.text:
The beginning of the [Tests/DaoTest.php] test is the following:

<?php

// respect strict des types déclarés des paramètres et des résultats des fonctions
declare(strict_types=1);

// espace de noms des tests
namespace Application\Tests;

// les classes testées
use Application\DaoImpotsWithTaxAdminDataInDatabase;
use Application\DaoTransferAdminDataFromJsonFile2Database;
use Application\ExceptionImpots;
use Application\InterfaceDao;
use Application\TaxAdminData;
use Application\TaxPayerData;
// les classes de PHPUnit
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\DataProvider;
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

// chargement des classes de la couche [dao] de la version 5
require_once __DIR__ . "/../../version-05/Entities/ExceptionImpots.php";

docs.title: 15. Practical exercise – version 7
docs.text:
Version 7 takes version 6 and moves the constants used in the main scripts out into a configuration file: the names of the data files and the list of PHP files to load. Like version 6, it contains no new class and uses those of version 5:

version-07
├── Data
│   ├── config.json
│   ├── database-mysql.json
│   ├── database-pgsql.json
│   ├── errors.json
│   ├── results.json
│   ├── taxadmindata.json
│   └── taxpayersdata.json
├── Main
│   ├── MainCalculateImpotsWithTaxAdminDataInDatabase.php
│   └── MainTransferAdminDataFromJsonFile2Database.php
└── Tests
    ├── DaoTest.php
    └── MetierTest.php

The [Data] folder contains the descriptions of the two [dbimpots-2019] databases: the MySQL database of version 5 [database-mysql.json] and the PostgreSQL database of version 6 [database-pgsql.json]. In the latter file, the table names are no longer prefixed with the [public] schema (["tableTranches": "tbtranches"]).

docs.title: 15.1. Implementation
docs.text:
The configuration file is the following JSON file [Data/config.json]:

{
    "databaseFilename": "Data/database-pgsql.json",
    "taxAdminDataFilename": "Data/taxadmindata.json",
    "taxPayersDataFilename": "Data/taxpayersdata.json",
    "resultsFilename": "Data/results.json",
    "errorsFilename": "Data/errors.json",
    "dependencies": {
        "ExceptionImpots": "../version-05/Entities/ExceptionImpots.php",
        "TaxAdminData": "../version-05/Entities/TaxAdminData.php",
        "TaxPayerData": "../version-05/Entities/TaxPayerData.php",
        "Database": "../version-05/Entities/Database.php",
        "Utilitaires": "../version-05/Utilities/Utilitaires.php",
        "InterfaceDao": "../version-05/Dao/InterfaceDao.php",
        "TraitDao": "../version-05/Dao/TraitDao.php",
        "DaoImpotsWithTaxAdminDataInDatabase": "../version-05/Dao/DaoImpotsWithTaxAdminDataInDatabase.php",
        "InterfaceDao4TransferAdminData2Database": "../version-05/Dao/InterfaceDao4TransferAdminData2Database.php",
        "DaoTransferAdminDataFromJsonFile2Database": "../version-05/Dao/DaoTransferAdminDataFromJsonFile2Database.php",
        "InterfaceMetier": "../version-05/Metier/InterfaceMetier.php",
        "Metier": "../version-05/Metier/Metier.php"
    },
    "dependencies4calculate": [
        "ExceptionImpots",
        "TaxAdminData",
        "TaxPayerData",
        "Database",
        "Utilitaires",
        "InterfaceDao",
        "TraitDao",
        "DaoImpotsWithTaxAdminDataInDatabase",
        "InterfaceMetier",
        "Metier"
    ],
    "dependencies4transfer": [
        "ExceptionImpots",
        "TaxAdminData",
        "Database",
        "Utilitaires",
        "InterfaceDao4TransferAdminData2Database",
        "DaoTransferAdminDataFromJsonFile2Database"
    ]
}

In this configuration:

  • lines 2-6: the paths of all the application's JSON files. The database used is the PostgreSQL database;
  • lines 7-20: the paths of all the application's PHP files, in the form [key => path]. These are the version 5 files;
  • lines 21-32: the dependencies of the tax calculation, in the form of a list of keys of the [dependencies] dictionary;
  • lines 33-40: the dependencies of the transfer to the database of the data in the JSON file [taxadmindata.json], in the same form.

All the paths are relative to the [version-07] folder. The PHP 7 course added to this file a [rootDirectory] key giving the absolute path of the version's folder on the author's machine (["C:/Data/st-2019/dev/php7/poly/scripts-console/impots/version-07"]): it had to be changed on every new machine. The scripts now compute this folder themselves from the [__DIR__] constant. The [php8-oct-2026] folder can thus be placed anywhere.

The script that transfers the tax administration's data to the database [Main/MainTransferAdminDataFromJsonFile2Database.php] becomes the following:

<?php

// respect strict des types déclarés des paramètres et des résultats des fonctions
declare(strict_types=1);

// espace de noms
namespace Application;

// le dossier racine de la version 7 : les chemins du fichier de configuration sont relatifs à ce dossier
const ROOT_DIRECTORY = __DIR__ . "/..";
// chemin du fichier de configuration
const CONFIG_FILENAME = ROOT_DIRECTORY . "/Data/config.json";

// on récupère la configuration
$config = json_decode(file_get_contents(CONFIG_FILENAME), true, flags: JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);

// on inclut les dépendances nécessaires au script
foreach ($config["dependencies4transfer"] as $dependency) {
    require_once ROOT_DIRECTORY . "/" . $config["dependencies"][$dependency];
}

// les chemins des fichiers de données
$databaseFilename = ROOT_DIRECTORY . "/" . $config["databaseFilename"];
$taxAdminDataFilename = ROOT_DIRECTORY . "/" . $config["taxAdminDataFilename"];

try {
    // création de la couche [dao]
    $dao = new DaoTransferAdminDataFromJsonFile2Database($databaseFilename, $taxAdminDataFilename);
    // transfert des données dans la base
    $dao->transferAdminData2Database();
    print "Les données de l'administration fiscale ont été transférées dans la base décrite par [{$config["databaseFilename"]}]\n";
} catch (ExceptionImpots $ex) {
    // on affiche l'erreur
    print "Erreur n° {$ex->getCode()} : {$ex->getMessage()}\n";
}
// fin
print "Terminé\n";

Comments

The code remains that of version 6. The only difference is the use of the [config.json] file instead of constants:

  • line 10: the root folder of version 7, from which the paths in the configuration file are measured. [__DIR__] is the script's [Main] folder, [__DIR__ . "/.."] its parent folder [version-07];
  • line 12: the path of the configuration file;
  • line 15: the [file_get_contents] function reads the [config.json] file into a character string. The [json_decode] function then uses this string to build the associative array [$config]. The second parameter [true] of the [json_decode] function indicates that we want an associative array rather than an object. With the [JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR] option, a syntax error in the file throws a [JsonException] exception. We do not try to handle errors reading the configuration file here: this file is part of the application, and an error in it is a programming error that PHP reports itself. Data errors (JSON data files, database), on the other hand, are always reported by an [ExceptionImpots];
  • lines 18-20: we include the dependencies needed by the transfer script:
    • [$config["dependencies4transfer"]] is the array of dependencies needed by the transfer script. It is a list of keys;
    • the paths of the files to include are found in the [$config["dependencies"]] dictionary and prefixed with the root folder. For example, the key [ExceptionImpots] gives the file [version-07/../version-05/Entities/ExceptionImpots.php];
    • [require_once] (and not [require] as in the PHP 7 course) guarantees that a file is not loaded twice, which would cause the fatal error "Cannot redeclare class … (previously declared in …)";
  • lines 23-24: the full paths of the data files. The PHP 7 course put them in constants created by the [define] function. Variables are enough;
  • line 31: we display the name of the file describing the database used. In a double-quoted string, the array element [$config["databaseFilename"]] must be surrounded by braces.

The results:

> php MainTransferAdminDataFromJsonFile2Database.php
Les données de l'administration fiscale ont été transférées dans la base décrite par [Data/database-pgsql.json]
Terminé

In the same way, the tax calculation script becomes the following [Main/MainCalculateImpotsWithTaxAdminDataInDatabase.php]:

<?php

// respect strict des types déclarés des paramètres et des résultats des fonctions
declare(strict_types=1);

// espace de noms
namespace Application;

// le dossier racine de la version 7 : les chemins du fichier de configuration sont relatifs à ce dossier
const ROOT_DIRECTORY = __DIR__ . "/..";
// chemin du fichier de configuration
const CONFIG_FILENAME = ROOT_DIRECTORY . "/Data/config.json";

// on récupère la configuration
$config = json_decode(file_get_contents(CONFIG_FILENAME), true, flags: JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);

// on inclut les dépendances nécessaires au script
foreach ($config["dependencies4calculate"] as $dependency) {
    require_once ROOT_DIRECTORY . "/" . $config["dependencies"][$dependency];
}

// les chemins des fichiers de données
$databaseFilename = ROOT_DIRECTORY . "/" . $config["databaseFilename"];
$taxPayersDataFilename = ROOT_DIRECTORY . "/" . $config["taxPayersDataFilename"];
$resultsFilename = ROOT_DIRECTORY . "/" . $config["resultsFilename"];
$errorsFilename = ROOT_DIRECTORY . "/" . $config["errorsFilename"];

try {
    // création de la couche [dao]
    $dao = new DaoImpotsWithTaxAdminDataInDatabase($databaseFilename);
    // création de la couche [métier]
    $métier = new Metier($dao);
    // calcul de l'impôt en mode batch
    $métier->executeBatchImpots($taxPayersDataFilename, $resultsFilename, $errorsFilename);
    print "Les résultats ont été enregistrés dans le fichier [{$config["resultsFilename"]}]\n";
} catch (ExceptionImpots $ex) {
    // on affiche l'erreur
    print "Erreur n° {$ex->getCode()} : {$ex->getMessage()}\n";
}
// fin
print "Terminé\n";
  • lines 18-20: this time we include the dependencies of the tax calculation;
  • lines 23-26: the paths of the application's JSON files;
  • lines 28-39: the rest of the code is that of version 6.

The results:

> php MainCalculateImpotsWithTaxAdminDataInDatabase.php
Les résultats ont été enregistrés dans le fichier [Data/results.json]
Terminé

The [Data/results.json] file produced is identical to the [resultats.json] file of versions 5 and 6.

The names of the two scripts have changed. In the PHP 7 course, they mentioned PostgreSQL ([MainTransferAdminDataFromFile2PostgresSQLDatabase.php], [MainCalculateImpotsWithTaxAdminDataInPostgresDatabase.php]). But these scripts no longer depend on any DBMS: the DBMS is chosen by the [databaseFilename] key of the configuration file. If we replace ["Data/database-pgsql.json"] there with ["Data/database-mysql.json"], the transfer script works with the MySQL database, without a single line of PHP code being modified:

> php MainTransferAdminDataFromJsonFile2Database.php
Les données de l'administration fiscale ont été transférées dans la base décrite par [Data/database-mysql.json]
Terminé

This is the point of a configuration file: the application is adapted to its environment (DBMS, file locations…) without touching the code. We will meet this configuration file again in the following versions of the application.

docs.title: 15.2. [PHPUnit] tests
docs.text: This version, like the previous ones, is validated by [PHPUnit] tests. Their environment is also built from the configuration file.

docs.title: 15.2.1. Testing the [dao] layer
docs.text:
The tests of the [dao] layer will use the two database descriptions in the [Data] folder: this way we check with the same tests that the [dao] layer works with MySQL and with PostgreSQL. The [Tests/DaoTest.php] test is the following:

<?php

// respect strict des types déclarés des paramètres et des résultats des fonctions
declare(strict_types=1);

// espace de noms des tests
namespace Application\Tests;

// les classes testées
use Application\DaoImpotsWithTaxAdminDataInDatabase;
use Application\DaoTransferAdminDataFromJsonFile2Database;
use Application\TaxAdminData;
// les classes de PHPUnit
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\DataProvider;
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

final class DaoTest extends TestCase
{
    // le dossier racine de la version 7
    private const string ROOT_DIRECTORY = __DIR__ . "/..";
    // la configuration de l'application
    private static array $config;

    // exécutée une fois, avant le premier test de la classe
    #[\Override]
    public static function setUpBeforeClass(): void
    {
        // on récupère la configuration
        self::$config = json_decode(file_get_contents(self::ROOT_DIRECTORY . "/Data/config.json"), true, flags: JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);
        // on inclut les dépendances du calcul de l'impôt et celles du transfert des données
        $dependencies = array_unique([...self::$config["dependencies4calculate"], ...self::$config["dependencies4transfer"]]);
        foreach ($dependencies as $dependency) {
            require_once self::ROOT_DIRECTORY . "/" . self::$config["dependencies"][$dependency];
        }
    }

    // les deux bases de données
    public static function bases(): array
    {
        // [fichier de description de la base]
        return [
            "MySQL" => ["Data/database-mysql.json"],
            "PostgreSQL" => ["Data/database-pgsql.json"],
        ];
    }

    // les données de l'administration fiscale lues dans la base de données
    #[DataProvider("bases")]
    public function testTaxAdminData(string $databaseFilename): void
    {
        $dao = new DaoImpotsWithTaxAdminDataInDatabase(self::ROOT_DIRECTORY . "/$databaseFilename");
        $taxAdminData = $dao->getTaxAdminData();
        // constantes de calcul
        $this->assertSame(1551.0, $taxAdminData->plafondQfDemiPart);
        $this->assertSame(21037.0, $taxAdminData->plafondRevenusCelibatairePourReduction);
        $this->assertSame(42074.0, $taxAdminData->plafondRevenusCouplePourReduction);
        $this->assertSame(3797.0, $taxAdminData->valeurReducDemiPart);
        $this->assertSame(1196.0, $taxAdminData->plafondDecoteCelibataire);
        $this->assertSame(1970.0, $taxAdminData->plafondDecoteCouple);
        $this->assertSame(1595.0, $taxAdminData->plafondImpotCelibatairePourDecote);
        $this->assertSame(2627.0, $taxAdminData->plafondImpotCouplePourDecote);
        $this->assertSame(12502.0, $taxAdminData->abattementDixPourcentMax);
        $this->assertSame(437.0, $taxAdminData->abattementDixPourcentMin);
        // tranches de l'impôt
        $this->assertSame([9964.0, 27519.0, 73779.0, 156244.0, 0.0], $taxAdminData->limites);
        $this->assertSame([0.0, 0.14, 0.30, 0.41, 0.45], $taxAdminData->coeffR);
        $this->assertSame([0.0, 1394.96, 5798.0, 13913.69, 20163.45], $taxAdminData->coeffN);
    }

    // le transfert du fichier JSON vers la base, puis la relecture de la base
    #[DataProvider("bases")]
    public function testTransfert(string $databaseFilename): void
    {
        // les fichiers JSON
        $databaseFilename = self::ROOT_DIRECTORY . "/$databaseFilename";
        $taxAdminDataFilename = self::ROOT_DIRECTORY . "/" . self::$config["taxAdminDataFilename"];
        // transfert
        (new DaoTransferAdminDataFromJsonFile2Database($databaseFilename, $taxAdminDataFilename))->transferAdminData2Database();
        // relecture de la base par une couche [dao]
        $dao = new DaoImpotsWithTaxAdminDataInDatabase($databaseFilename);
        // la base contient les données du fichier JSON
        $this->assertEquals(TaxAdminData::fromJsonFile($taxAdminDataFilename), $dao->getTaxAdminData());
    }
}

Comments

  • lines 10-12: the classes under test are imported. The [use] statement does not load the classes: it only lets us refer to them by their short name;
  • line 22: the application's configuration, in a static (class) attribute;
  • lines 26-35: the static method [setUpBeforeClass] of [TestCase] is executed only once, before the first test of the class. This is where we read the configuration file and load the application's files. The PHP 7 course did this work at the top level of the test file, outside the class. With PHPUnit, that code is executed when PHPUnit loads the file, at a moment we do not control; the [setUpBeforeClass] method is designed for this purpose;
  • line 31: the tests of the [dao] layer need the dependencies of the tax calculation (for the [DaoImpotsWithTaxAdminDataInDatabase] class) and those of the transfer (for the [DaoTransferAdminDataFromJsonFile2Database] class). We merge the two lists, then the [array_unique] function removes the duplicates;
  • lines 38-45: the data provider: the description files of the two databases;
  • lines 48-49: the [testTaxAdminData] test of version 5 is run once for each of the two databases;
  • lines 71-83: likewise for the test of the transfer of data from the JSON file to the database.

docs.title: 18. Practical exercise – version 8
docs.text: We are going to take the example application – version 5 (and its version 7, configured by a JSON file) and turn it into a client / server application. In this way we put into practice what we learned in the previous chapter about web services.

docs.title: 18.1. Introduction
docs.text:
The architecture of version 5 was as follows:

  • the layer called [dao] (Data Access Objects) handles exchanges with the MySQL database and the local file system;
  • the layer called [métier] performs the tax calculation;
  • the main script is the conductor: it instantiates the [dao] and [métier] layers and then talks to the [métier] layer to do what needs to be done.

We are going to migrate this architecture to the following client / server architecture:

  • in [2], we will reuse the [dao] layer of version 5, removing its methods for accessing the local file system. These methods will migrate to the client's [dao] layer [6, 7];
  • in [3], the [métier] layer will remain that of version 5 without its [executeBatchImpots] method, which migrates to the client's [métier] layer [8];
  • in [4], the server script has to be written: it will have to:
    • create the [métier] and [dao] layers [3, 2];
    • talk to the client script [5, 7];
  • in [7], the client's [dao] layer has to be written:
    • it will be an HTTP client of the server script [4, 5];
    • it will reuse the local file system access methods of the [dao] layer of version 5;
  • in [8], the client's [métier] layer will offer the same methods as the [InterfaceMetier] interface of version 5. Its implementation will however be different. In version 5, the [métier] layer performed the tax calculation. Here, it is the server's [métier] layer that performs this calculation. The client's [métier] layer will therefore call on the [dao] layer [7] to talk to the server and ask it to calculate the tax;
  • in [9], the console script will have to instantiate the client's [dao, métier] layers and start its execution.

The server is a web script: it is placed in the [scripts-web/impots/version-08] folder and executed by the Apache server of [Laragon]. The client is a console script: it is placed in the [scripts-console/impots/version-08] folder and executed in a terminal.

docs.title: 18.2. The server
docs.text:
We now focus on the server part of the application.

This architecture will be implemented by the following files:

scripts-web/impots/version-08
├── Dao
│   ├── InterfaceServerDao.php
│   └── ServerDao.php
├── Data
│   ├── .htaccess
│   ├── config-server.json
│   ├── database-mysql.json
│   └── database-pgsql.json
├── Metier
│   ├── InterfaceServerMetier.php
│   └── ServerMetier.php
├── Tests
│   ├── ServerDaoTest.php
│   └── ServerMetierTest.php
└── impots-server.php

docs.title: 18.2.1. The entities exchanged between layers
docs.text: The entities exchanged between layers are those of version 5: the [ExceptionImpots] exception, the tax authority data [TaxAdminData] and the database description [Database]. The server also uses the [Utilitaires] class of version 5, whose [lireFichierJson] method is used by the [Database] class. The PHP 7 course copied these files into the server's folder. We load them directly from the [scripts-console/impots/version-05] folder: in this way a class exists in only one copy, and a fix made in version 5 benefits all the versions that use it.

docs.title: 18.2.2. The [dao] layer
docs.text:
The [dao] layer implements the following [InterfaceServerDao] interface:

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

// espace de noms
namespace Application;

// l'interface de la couche [dao] du serveur
interface InterfaceServerDao
{
    // lecture des données de l'administration fiscale
    // lance une exception [ExceptionImpots] en cas d'erreur
    public function getTaxAdminData(): TaxAdminData;
}
  • line 13: the [getTaxAdminData] method fetches the tax authority data from a database.

The [InterfaceServerDao] interface is implemented by the following [ServerDao] class:

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

// espace de noms
namespace Application;

// la couche [dao] du serveur : elle trouve les données de l'administration fiscale dans une base de données
// c'est la classe [DaoImpotsWithTaxAdminDataInDatabase] de la version 5 sans les méthodes
// qui travaillent avec les fichiers JSON des contribuables
class ServerDao implements InterfaceServerDao
{
    // la description de la base de données
    private readonly Database $database;
    // l'objet de type [TaxAdminData] qui contient les données de l'administration fiscale
    // [protected] : les classes dérivées pourront l'initialiser
    protected readonly TaxAdminData $taxAdminData;

    // le constructeur
    public function __construct(string $databaseFilename)
    {
        // la description de la base de données - peut lancer une exception [ExceptionImpots]
        $this->database = Database::fromJsonFile($databaseFilename);
        $database = $this->database;
        try {
            // on ouvre la connexion à la base de données
            // les lignes lues seront rendues sous la forme de tableaux associatifs [colonne => valeur]
            $connexion = \PDO::connect(
                $database->dsn,
                $database->id,
                $database->pwd,
                [\PDO::ATTR_DEFAULT_FETCH_MODE => \PDO::FETCH_ASSOC]
            );
            // on démarre une transaction
            $connexion->beginTransaction();
            // on lit la table des tranches d'impôt
            $tranches = $this->getTranches($connexion);
            // on lit la table des constantes
            $constantes = $this->getConstantes($connexion);
            // on termine la transaction sur un succès
            $connexion->commit();
        } catch (\PDOException $ex) {
            // y a-t-il une transaction en cours ?
            if (isset($connexion) && $connexion->inTransaction()) {
                // on termine la transaction sur un échec
                $connexion->rollBack();
            }
            // on remonte l'erreur au code appelant sous la forme d'une exception [ExceptionImpots]
            throw new ExceptionImpots("Erreur d'accès à la base de données ({$ex->getMessage()})", 30, $ex);
        }
        // construction de l'objet [TaxAdminData] : les données lues sont vérifiées
        $this->taxAdminData = TaxAdminData::fromArray([...$tranches, ...$constantes]);
    }

This is the code of the [DaoImpotsWithTaxAdminDataInDatabase] class of version 5, presented in chapter 13, without the [TraitDao] trait that provided the methods for reading and writing the taxpayers' JSON files. The private methods [getTranches] and [getConstantes] that follow, not reproduced here, are unchanged. There is only one difference:

  • line 17: the [taxAdminData] attribute is declared [protected] and no longer [private]. Version 9 will derive the [ServerDao] class, and the derived class will need to be able to initialize this attribute. Since PHP 8.4, a derived class can initialize an inherited [readonly] attribute, provided it is not private.

docs.title: 18.2.3. The [métier] layer
docs.text:
The [métier] layer implements the following [InterfaceServerMetier] interface:

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

// espace de noms
namespace Application;

// l'interface de la couche [métier] du serveur
interface InterfaceServerMetier
{
    // calcul de l'impôt d'un contribuable
    // rend le tableau [impôt, surcôte, décôte, réduction, taux]
    public function calculerImpot(string $marié, int $enfants, int $salaire): array;
}

The [InterfaceServerMetier] interface is implemented by the following [ServerMetier] class:

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

// espace de noms
namespace Application;

// la couche [métier] du serveur : la classe [Metier] de la version 5 sans la méthode [executeBatchImpots]
class ServerMetier implements InterfaceServerMetier
{
    // données de l'administration fiscale
    private readonly TaxAdminData $taxAdminData;

    // la couche [dao] est injectée par le constructeur
    public function __construct(private readonly InterfaceServerDao $dao)
    {
        // on récupère les données permettant le calcul de l'impôt
        // la méthode [getTaxAdminData] peut lancer une exception [ExceptionImpots]
        // on la laisse alors remonter au code appelant
        $this->taxAdminData = $this->dao->getTaxAdminData();
    }

    // calcul de l'impôt
    // --------------------------------------------------------------------------
    #[\Override]
    public function calculerImpot(string $marié, int $enfants, int $salaire): array
  • line 9: the [ServerMetier] class is the [Metier] class of version 5 without its [executeBatchImpots] method;
  • line 15: the constructor receives a reference to a [dao] layer of type [InterfaceServerDao];
  • line 26: the [calculerImpot] method and the private methods it uses are unchanged. The algorithm was presented and commented on from version 1 onwards, and its object version in chapter 13.

docs.title: 18.2.4. The server script
docs.text:
The server script [impots-server.php] implements the [web] layer [4]. It is configured by the following JSON file [Data/config-server.json]:

{
    "databaseFilename": "Data/database-mysql.json",
    "dependencies": [
        "../../../scripts-console/impots/version-05/Entities/ExceptionImpots.php",
        "../../../scripts-console/impots/version-05/Entities/TaxAdminData.php",
        "../../../scripts-console/impots/version-05/Entities/Database.php",
        "../../../scripts-console/impots/version-05/Utilities/Utilitaires.php",
        "Dao/InterfaceServerDao.php",
        "Dao/ServerDao.php",
        "Metier/InterfaceServerMetier.php",
        "Metier/ServerMetier.php"
    ],
    "users": [
        {
            "login": "admin",
            "passwd": "admin"
        }
    ]
}
  • line 2: the JSON configuration file of the MySQL database. This is the [database-mysql.json] file of version 7. The [Data] folder also contains the [database-pgsql.json] file of the PostgreSQL database: changing this line is enough for the server to work with PostgreSQL;
  • lines 3-12: the application's PHP files, whose paths are relative to the server's [version-08] folder. The first four are those of version 5;
  • lines 13-18: the array of users authorized to use the application.

As in version 7, there is no longer a [rootDirectory] key: the script computes its root folder itself from the [__DIR__] constant. Nor is there an [absoluteDependencies] key any more, which gave the absolute path of [Composer]'s [vendor/autoload.php] file: it is found from [__DIR__].

The [config-server.json] file is placed in the server's [Data] folder, and therefore in the website's directory tree: without precautions, anyone could download it with the URL [https://localhost/php8-oct-2026/scripts-web/impots/version-08/Data/config-server.json] and read the users' credentials. The same goes for the [database-mysql.json] file, which contains the database password. The [Data] folder therefore contains a [.htaccess] file:

# le dossier [Data] contient des mots de passe : Apache refuse de servir ses fichiers
Require all denied

A [.htaccess] file contains Apache server configuration directives that apply to the folder containing it and to its subfolders. The [Require all denied] directive forbids access to the folder: Apache responds [403 Forbidden] to any request for a file in the [Data] folder. The PHP script, for its part, reads these files from disk without going through Apache and is not affected.

The [impots-server.php] script implements the [web] layer as follows:

<?php

// respect strict des types déclarés des paramètres et des résultats des fonctions
declare(strict_types=1);

// espace de noms
namespace Application;

// dépendances Symfony
use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\JsonResponse;
use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\Request;
use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\Response;

// le dossier racine du serveur : les chemins du fichier de configuration sont relatifs à ce dossier
const ROOT_DIRECTORY = __DIR__;
// chemin du fichier de configuration
const CONFIG_FILENAME = ROOT_DIRECTORY . "/Data/config-server.json";

// on récupère la configuration
$config = json_decode(file_get_contents(CONFIG_FILENAME), true, flags: JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);

// on inclut les dépendances nécessaires au script
require_once ROOT_DIRECTORY . "/../../../vendor/autoload.php";
foreach ($config["dependencies"] as $dependency) {
    require_once ROOT_DIRECTORY . "/$dependency";
}

// préparation de la réponse JSON du serveur
$response = new JsonResponse();
// caractères accentués et / non échappés, réels toujours écrits avec un point décimal (0.0)
$response->setEncodingOptions(JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE | JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES | JSON_PRESERVE_ZERO_FRACTION);

// on récupère la requête courante
$request = Request::createFromGlobals();
// authentification : les identifiants envoyés par le client (null s'il n'en a pas envoyé)
$requestUser = $request->getUser();
$requestPassword = $request->getPassword();
// l'utilisateur fait-il partie des utilisateurs autorisés ?
$trouvé = $requestUser !== null && $requestPassword !== null
    && array_any(
        $config["users"],
        fn(array $user): bool => $user["login"] === $requestUser && hash_equals($user["passwd"], $requestPassword)
    );
if (!$trouvé) {
    // pas trouvé - code 401
    $response->setStatusCode(Response::HTTP_UNAUTHORIZED);
    $response->headers->set("WWW-Authenticate", 'Basic realm="Serveur de calcul des impots"');
    // message d'erreur
    $response->setData(["réponse" => ["erreur" => "Echec de l'authentification [$requestUser]"]]);
    $response->send();
    // fin
    exit;
}

// on a un utilisateur valide - on vérifie les paramètres reçus
$erreurs = [];
// on doit avoir une requête GET avec trois paramètres
if ($request->getMethod() !== "GET" || $request->query->count() !== 3) {
    $erreurs[] = "Méthode GET requise avec les seuls paramètres [marié, enfants, salaire]";
}
// le statut marital
if (!$request->query->has("marié")) {
    $erreurs[] = "paramètre marié manquant";
} else {
    $marié = strtolower(trim($request->query->getString("marié")));
    if (!in_array($marié, ["oui", "non"], true)) {
        $erreurs[] = "paramètre marié [$marié] invalide";
    }
}
// le nombre d'enfants et le salaire : des nombres entiers >= 0
$valeurs = [];
foreach (["enfants", "salaire"] as $paramètre) {
    if (!$request->query->has($paramètre)) {
        $erreurs[] = "paramètre $paramètre manquant";
        continue;
    }
    $valeur = trim($request->query->getString($paramètre));
    if (preg_match('/^\d+$/', $valeur) !== 1) {
        $erreurs[] = "paramètre $paramètre [$valeur] invalide";
    } else {
        $valeurs[$paramètre] = (int) $valeur;
    }
}
// autres paramètres dans la requête ?
foreach (array_diff(array_keys($request->query->all()), ["marié", "enfants", "salaire"]) as $paramètre) {
    $erreurs[] = "paramètre [$paramètre] invalide";
}
// erreurs ?
if ($erreurs !== []) {
    // on envoie un code d'erreur 400 au client
    $response->setStatusCode(Response::HTTP_BAD_REQUEST);
    $response->setData(["réponse" => ["erreurs" => $erreurs]]);
    $response->send();
    exit;
}

// on a tout ce qu'il faut pour travailler
// création de l'architecture du serveur
try {
    // création de la couche [dao]
    $dao = new ServerDao(ROOT_DIRECTORY . "/" . $config["databaseFilename"]);
    // création de la couche [métier]
    $métier = new ServerMetier($dao);
} catch (ExceptionImpots $ex) {
    // le message d'erreur d'un pilote de SGBD peut ne pas être codé en UTF-8 (Windows-1252 sous Windows)
    $message = $ex->getMessage();
    if (!mb_check_encoding($message, "UTF-8")) {
        $message = mb_convert_encoding($message, "UTF-8", "Windows-1252");
    }
    // on envoie un code d'erreur 500 au client
    $response->setStatusCode(Response::HTTP_INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR);
    $response->setData(["réponse" => ["erreur" => $message]]);
    $response->send();
    exit;
}
// calcul de l'impôt
$result = $métier->calculerImpot($marié, $valeurs["enfants"], $valeurs["salaire"]);
// on rend la réponse
$response->setData(["réponse" => $result]);
$response->send();

Comments

  • lines 10-12: we declare the classes of the [HttpFoundation] library that we are going to use;
  • line 15: the server's root folder is the script's folder;
  • line 20: we use the configuration file;
  • lines 23-26: we load [Composer]'s class loader, then all the application's files;
  • line 29: we prepare a JSON response. The [JsonResponse] class is a class derived from [Response]: its [setData] method encodes the array it is given as JSON and makes it the response document. It also sets the HTTP header [Content-Type: application/json];
  • line 31: the options of the [json_encode] function used by [setData]. With [JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE], accented characters are not encoded as [\uXXXX]. With [JSON_PRESERVE_ZERO_FRACTION], the real tax rate [0.0] is written [0.0] and not [0]: the client will decode it as a real number (float) and not as an integer;
  • lines 36-37: we retrieve the credentials sent by the client, as in the previous chapter;
  • lines 39-43: we check that the user is indeed one of the authorized users. The [array_any] function (PHP 8.4) returns [true] if at least one of the elements of the [$config["users"]] array satisfies the condition expressed by the arrow function passed to it. It replaces the [while] loop of the PHP 7 script. The passwords are compared with [hash_equals];
  • lines 44-52: if not, we send the HTTP code [401 Unauthorized], which indicates that access is refused. On receiving this code and the HTTP header [WWW-Authenticate: Basic realm=…], browsers display an authentication window inviting the user to log in;
  • line 49: the server's JSON response explains the cause of the error ("Echec de l'authentification": authentication failed). All the server's responses will be the JSON string of an array [["réponse" => qqChose]]. The PHP 7 script sent the rejected login and password back to the client. A password must never be sent back, nor written to logs: we only send back the login;
  • lines 56-88: we check the validity of the request:
    • a GET request with exactly three parameters;
    • a [marié] parameter whose value must be [oui] or [non];
    • an [enfants] parameter whose value must be an integer >= 0;
    • a [salaire] parameter whose value must be an integer >= 0;
    • no other parameter;
  • line 59: each time an error is detected, an error message is added to the [$erreurs] array;
  • line 65: the [getString] method of the [$request->query] object returns the value of the parameter as a string;
  • line 72: the [enfants] and [salaire] parameters obey the same rule: we check them in the same loop. Their values, converted to integers, are placed in the [$valeurs] array;
  • line 85: the [array_diff] function returns the names of the parameters received that are not in the list [marié, enfants, salaire];
  • line 89: if there is an error, we send the HTTP code [400 Bad Request] to the client. The JSON response contains the list of errors;
  • lines 99-104: from here on, the request has been checked. We can instantiate the [dao, métier] layers. This instantiation has a cost (reading the database), and it should only be done if we are sure we have a valid request. Constructing the [dao] layer may throw an exception of type [ExceptionImpots];
  • lines 106-108: the error message is often that of the DBMS's PDO driver. On Windows, it is sometimes encoded in Windows-1252 and not in UTF-8. But the [json_encode] function only accepts UTF-8 strings: [JsonResponse] would then throw an exception. The [mb_check_encoding] function checks the encoding of the string and the [mb_convert_encoding] function converts it if necessary. The PHP 7 script used the [utf8_encode] function, deprecated since PHP 8.2;
  • line 111: if an exception occurred, we send the HTTP code [500 Internal Server Error] to the client. This code means that the server was unable to process a request that was nevertheless valid. The response explains the cause of the error;
  • line 117: the tax calculation is delegated to the [métier] layer;
  • lines 119-120: sending the response, with the status code [200 OK] by default.

Let's test this script. As in the previous chapter, we use a secure URL (HTTPS), since the client sends its credentials. In a browser, let's request the URL [https://localhost/php8-oct-2026/scripts-web/impots/version-08/impots-server.php?marié=oui&enfants=2&salaire=55555]. The browser first warns us that the server's self-signed certificate is not trustworthy; we agree to continue. It then displays its authentication window, in which we type [admin] and [admin]. It then displays the server's JSON response.

Let's make the same request with [curl]. Non-ASCII characters in a URL must be encoded: the character [é] of the [marié] parameter is encoded [%C3%A9] (its two bytes in UTF-8). A browser does this encoding itself:

> curl -i -k -u admin:admin "https://localhost/php8-oct-2026/scripts-web/impots/version-08/impots-server.php?mari%C3%A9=oui&enfants=2&salaire=55555"
HTTP/1.0 200 OK
Date: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 16:02:44 GMT
Server: Apache/2.4.58 (Ubuntu)
X-Powered-By: PHP/8.5.11
Cache-Control: no-cache, private
Connection: close
Content-Type: application/json

{"réponse":{"impôt":2814,"surcôte":0,"décôte":0,"réduction":0,"taux":0.14}}
  • line 2: the code [200 OK];
  • line 8: the HTTP header [Content-Type: application/json] set by the [JsonResponse] class;
  • line 10: the server's JSON response.

Without credentials (no [-u] option), we get the code [401 Unauthorized]:

> curl -i -k "https://localhost/php8-oct-2026/scripts-web/impots/version-08/impots-server.php?mari%C3%A9=oui&enfants=2&salaire=55555"
HTTP/1.0 401 Unauthorized
Date: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 16:02:44 GMT
Server: Apache/2.4.58 (Ubuntu)
X-Powered-By: PHP/8.5.11
Cache-Control: no-cache, private
WWW-Authenticate: Basic realm="Serveur de calcul des impots"
Connection: close
Content-Type: application/json

{"réponse":{"erreur":"Echec de l'authentification []"}}

Let's run a few error tests. We request the URL [https://localhost/php8-oct-2026/scripts-web/impots/version-08/impots-server.php?marié=x&enfants=x&salaire=x&w=x]:

> curl -i -k -u admin:admin "https://localhost/php8-oct-2026/scripts-web/impots/version-08/impots-server.php?mari%C3%A9=x&enfants=x&salaire=x&w=x"
HTTP/1.0 400 Bad Request
Date: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 16:48:38 GMT
Server: Apache/2.4.58 (Ubuntu)
X-Powered-By: PHP/8.5.11
Cache-Control: no-cache, private
Connection: close
Content-Type: application/json

{"réponse":{"erreurs":["Méthode GET requise avec les seuls paramètres [marié, enfants, salaire]","paramètre marié [x] invalide","paramètre enfants [x] invalide","paramètre salaire [x] invalide","paramètre [w] invalide"]}}

A POST request without parameters ([curl]'s [-X POST] option):

> curl -i -k -u admin:admin -X POST "https://localhost/php8-oct-2026/scripts-web/impots/version-08/impots-server.php"
HTTP/1.0 400 Bad Request
Date: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 16:48:38 GMT
Server: Apache/2.4.58 (Ubuntu)
X-Powered-By: PHP/8.5.11
Cache-Control: no-cache, private
Connection: close
Content-Type: application/json

{"réponse":{"erreurs":["Méthode GET requise avec les seuls paramètres [marié, enfants, salaire]","paramètre marié manquant","paramètre enfants manquant","paramètre salaire manquant"]}}

Now let's simulate a DBMS failure. We could stop MySQL from the [Laragon] window. Instead, we changed the DSN in the [database-mysql.json] file to [mysql:host=127.0.0.1;port=3307;dbname=dbimpots-2019;charset=utf8mb4]: no DBMS is listening on port 3307 and the connection is refused, as it would be if MySQL were stopped:

> curl -i -k -u admin:admin "https://localhost/php8-oct-2026/scripts-web/impots/version-08/impots-server.php?mari%C3%A9=oui&enfants=3&salaire=60000"
HTTP/1.0 500 Internal Server Error
Date: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 16:02:49 GMT
Server: Apache/2.4.58 (Ubuntu)
X-Powered-By: PHP/8.5.11
Cache-Control: no-cache, private
Connection: close
Content-Type: application/json

{"réponse":{"erreur":"Erreur d'accès à la base de données (SQLSTATE[HY000] [2002] Connection refused)"}}
  • line 2: the code [500 Internal Server Error];
  • line 10: the message of the [ExceptionImpots] exception thrown by the [dao] layer. On a French Windows, the driver's message is in French: [Aucune connexion n'a pu être établie car l'ordinateur cible l'a expressément refusée] (No connection could be made because the target machine actively refused it).

We then put the original DSN back.

docs.title: 18.2.5. [PHPUnit] tests
docs.text: Each time we build a new version of the server, we will test the [dao] and [métier] layers as has been done since version 4. These tests do not go through the web server: they build the [dao] and [métier] layers the way the server script does and test them directly. They are placed in the server's [Tests] folder. The PHP 7 course used the [Codeception] testing framework; we use [PHPUnit], as in the previous chapters.

docs.title: 18.2.5.1. Tests of the [dao] layer
docs.text:
The [Tests/ServerDaoTest.php] test is as follows:

<?php

// respect strict des types déclarés des paramètres et des résultats des fonctions
declare(strict_types=1);

// espace de noms des tests
namespace Application\Tests;

// la classe testée
use Application\ServerDao;
// les classes de PHPUnit
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

final class ServerDaoTest extends TestCase
{
    // le dossier racine du serveur
    private const string ROOT_DIRECTORY = __DIR__ . "/..";
    // la configuration du serveur
    private static array $config;

    // exécutée une fois, avant le premier test de la classe
    #[\Override]
    public static function setUpBeforeClass(): void
    {
        // on récupère la configuration du serveur
        self::$config = json_decode(file_get_contents(self::ROOT_DIRECTORY . "/Data/config-server.json"), true, flags: JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);
        // on inclut les dépendances du serveur
        foreach (self::$config["dependencies"] as $dependency) {
            require_once self::ROOT_DIRECTORY . "/$dependency";
        }
    }

    // les données de l'administration fiscale lues dans la base de données
    public function testTaxAdminData(): void
    {
        // création de la couche [dao] comme dans le script serveur
        $dao = new ServerDao(self::ROOT_DIRECTORY . "/" . self::$config["databaseFilename"]);
        $taxAdminData = $dao->getTaxAdminData();
        // constantes de calcul
        $this->assertSame(1551.0, $taxAdminData->plafondQfDemiPart);
        $this->assertSame(21037.0, $taxAdminData->plafondRevenusCelibatairePourReduction);

Comments

  • lines 23-31: we build the same working environment as that of the server script [impots-server.php]: reading the configuration file and loading the application's files. [Composer]'s class loader does not need to be loaded: [PHPUnit] has already done so;
  • line 37: we build an instance of the [dao] layer to be tested, as is done in the server script;
  • from now on, we are in the same conditions as the server script: the rest of the [testTaxAdminData] method, not reproduced here, is that of the [DaoTest] test of versions 5 to 7.
